title: Project Manager - Data
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Project Manager \- Data
   

  

**Job ID:** 
 POS\-20692
   

  

**Primary Skill:** 
 P\&C
   

  

**Key Skills:** 
 Data Project Management, Project Delivery, Databricks, Agile/Scrum, Data Team Leadership
   

  

**Job Location:** 
 Hyderabad
   

  

**Experience:** 
 12–15 Years
   

  

**About The Job**
 We are looking for an experienced Data Technical Project Manager with strong expertise in Data Engineering, Databricks, Agile/Scrum, and end\-to\-end project delivery. The candidate will be responsible for managing data projects, coordinating cross\-functional technical teams, maintaining project governance, and ensuring successful delivery of data initiatives.
   

  

**Know Your Team**
 At ValueMomentum Technology Solution Centers, we are a team of passionate engineers who thrive on tackling complex business challenges while transforming the P\&C insurance value chain.
   

  

 Our expertise spans Cloud Engineering, Application Engineering, Data Engineering, Core Engineering, Quality Engineering, and Domain capabilities. Through our Infinity Program, we invest in continuous learning and role\-specific skill development, providing opportunities to contribute to impactful projects.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead and manage end\-to\-end data projects from planning and execution through delivery and closure.
* Run and facilitate daily Scrum calls, sprint planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.
* Guide and coordinate teams comprising Databricks Engineers, Data Analysts, Data Modelers, and other data professionals.
* Maintain and manage Azure DevOps (ADO) boards, ensuring work items, user stories, tasks, sprint assignments, priorities, status, and dependencies are updated accurately.
* Define project scope, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables with technical teams.
* Drive project execution using Agile/Scrum methodologies and ensure timely delivery within agreed scope and quality standards.
* Provide technical direction and facilitate discussions around data engineering, data architecture, data modelling, and Databricks solutions.
* Track project progress, identify risks, issues, dependencies, and blockers, and drive them to closure.
* Coordinate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, Engineering teams, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment.
* Monitor sprint commitments, team capacity, velocity, and delivery metrics.
* Ensure timely updates to project plans, sprint backlogs, action items, risks, and dependencies.
* Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, and key decisions to stakeholders and leadership.
* Support teams in resolving technical and functional challenges and facilitate collaboration across workstreams.
* Ensure adherence to project governance, delivery processes, documentation, and quality standards.
* Manage multiple priorities and workstreams while maintaining focus on project timelines and business outcomes.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of delivery processes, Agile practices, and team performance.


**Requirements**
* 12–15 years of experience in project management, with relevant experience in the P\&C Insurance industry.
* Strong experience in data project handling and end\-to\-end project delivery.
* Strong understanding of Data Engineering, Data Architecture, Data Modelling, and Databricks.
* Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies and Scrum ceremonies.
* Experience managing and coordinating cross\-functional data teams.
* Experience with Azure DevOps boards and project tracking.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, leadership, and organizational skills.
* Strong understanding of insurance processes, regulations, and market trends.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Insurance, or a related field.
* PMP, PgMP, or Scrum Master certification preferred.


**Good To Have**
* Experience with project management tools such as Microsoft Project, JIRA, or Rally.
* Experience managing multiple priorities and workstreams.
* Strong strategic thinking and business outcome orientation.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
* Strong team building and leadership abilities.


**About The Company**
 Founded in 2000 with the core belief that impactful change comes from deep commitment, ValueMomentum specializes in delivering measurable results across the P\&C value stream. For more than 25 years, we have empowered more than 100 carriers to reimagine their businesses with AI and emerging technologies, navigate market shifts, unlock speed to value, and become future\-ready. We help insurers in the US, Canada, and Europe stay ahead with sustained growth and high performance to enhance stakeholder value and foster resilient societies.
   

  

**Our culture – Our fuel**
 At ValueMomentum, we believe in making employees win by nurturing them from within, collaborating and looking out for each other.
   

  

* People firs \- Empower employees to succeed.
* Nurture leaders \- Nurture from within.
* Enjoy wins \- Recognize and celebrate win.
* Collaboration \- Foster a culture of collaboration and people\-centricity.
* Diversity \- Committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion.
* Fun \- Create a fun and engaging work environment


**Company Benefits**
* Compensation \- Competitive compensation package comparable to the best in the industry.
* Career Growth \- Career development, comprehensive training \& certification programs, and fast track growth for high potential associates.
* Health Benefits: Comprehensive health benefits and life insurance.

title: Project Manager
description:
**About Us:**
 Seismic is the Go\-To\-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer\-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3\.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia\-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.
   

  

 Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
   

  

**Overview:**
 The Project Manager leads end\-to\-end SaaS customer implementations, serving as the single point of contact responsible for both technical solution delivery and project governance for commercial and mid\-market engagements. We currently have 9 open positions for this role, supporting client onboarding from initial discovery through deployment and change management.
   

  

**Who you are:**
* 5\+ years of experience in professional services, management consulting, customer success, or SaaS implementation roles.
* Proven track record of managing enterprise SaaS implementation projects end\-to\-end.
* Demonstrated technical aptitude to learn SaaS product architecture and conduct basic technical configurations.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with experience communicating across business, technical, and executive levels.
* Experience in leading initiatives with cross\-functional teams on multiple concurrent engagements.
* Familiarity with project management tools (e.g., FinancialForce, Jira, Confluence, iCIMS).
* PMP or Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) certification is a plus.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.


**What you’ll be doing:**
* End\-to\-End Delivery Management: Manage a dynamic portfolio of 10\-20 concurrent customer implementations, maintaining high work quality, adherence to schedules, and customer satisfaction.
* Consulting \& Solutioning: Facilitate discovery workshops to understand business workflows, document requirements, and prescribe optimal platform configurations.
* Hands\-On Technical Configuration: Perform platform configuration, content taxonomy structuring, and low\-complexity technical setups (including SSO, sFTP, SMTP, user provisioning, and standard package modules).
* Project Governance \& Tracking: Maintain detailed project plans, track billable utilization and milestone completion, manage scope change orders, and issue weekly status reports.
* Risk Management \& Stakeholder Alignment: Proactively identify, communicate, and mitigate implementation risks, maintaining positive relationships with executive sponsors and project stakeholders.
* Training \& Enablement: Facilitate client enablement sessions (virtual and onsite) to ensure effective user adoption and smooth handoff to Customer Success.


**What we have for you:**
 At Seismic, we’re committed to providing benefits and perks for the whole self. To explore our benefits available in each country, please visit the Global Benefits page.
   

  

 If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the application or recruiting process, please click here.
   

  

 Seismic is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, age, race, religion, or any other classification which is protected by applicable law.
   

  

 Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

**Job Description:**
**About us\***
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. We hire individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and experiences and invest heavily in our teammates and their families by offering competitive benefits to support their physical, emotional, and financial well\-being.
   

  

 Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi\-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.
   

  

 Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!
   

  

 Global Business Services
   

  

 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 CFO Change Automation team, which is part of CFO COO group in involved in various analytics, automation and reporting \& governance needs that helps the CFO group analyze and address key challenges \& provide relevant solutions using ET or any other relevant technologies. The team provides deep dive analysis by deploying analytics and data mining tools like SQL, Alteryx, Tableau, Workiva etc. as well as is involved in setting up automated solutions for complex BAU processes.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 CFO Change Automation team aims in driving opportunity assessment, prioritization, and process automation \& governance across all verticals of CFO.
   

  

 In support of CFO Change objectives this position will be responsible for managing the end to end delivery of complex initiatives from a functional leader perspective. His expertise will be to bridge the gap between business needs \& designing technical solutions coupled with his efficiency in ET.
   

  

 This person will be responsible for assisting business teams to expedite implementation of automated solutions through collaboration with other CFO and Enterprise Architecture teams to provide a consistent and governed approach in accordance with data management and tech strategy models. This person would serve in an execution role to support business with new and emerging tools used in process optimization efforts and driving Operational Excellence.
   

  

 This initiative execution/ business integration role will require the individual to lead, manage, and deliver on the end to end scope of Automation initiatives. This individual will get significant exposure to senior stakeholders across CFO through leading initiative routines to communicate project progress, governance, new opportunities and key decisions.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Lead the end\-to\-end design and delivery of intelligent agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio, including workflow orchestration, system integrations, and scalable automation use cases.
* Design and manage end\-to\-end automation workflows, ensuring scalability, stability, and measurable business impact.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to translate functional requirements into AI\-driven agent solutions, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance, and control standards.
* Stay updated with evolving AI and automation toolsets, enabling scalable and practical AI\-powered workflows
* Lead development of solutions on low\-code/no\-code platforms (e.g., Alteryx, Tableau, automation tools, workflow engines)
* Effectively manage the end to end delivery of their Automation projects / initiatives

* Strong knowledge in data warehousing concepts. Good understanding of RPA (UiPath), Alteryx, Tableau, Workiva, VB, SQL, Data Modeling and other newly upcoming technologies.


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Bachelor’s degree (preferably in Computer Science, Data Science etc)
   

  

 Post Graduate (MCA or equivalent degree)
   

  

 Certifications If Any
   

  

 Technical certifications in Microsoft Copilot M365, Studio, RPA tools like UiPath, Alteryx Advanced and Tableau preferred

 7\-10 years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Practical experience with generative AI tools (e.g., Microsoft 365 Copilot), including the ability to frame effective prompts and apply AI outputs for accurate, relevant, and reusable business deliverables
* Strong analytical judgment and risk awareness, with experience using AI for data analysis and executive ready insights (e.g., variance, trends), while ensuring appropriate controls, validation, and human review of automated outputs

**Desired Skills**

title: Senior Manager, Software Development & Engineering Lead (PL)
description:
Your opportunity

Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
   

  

 Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values\-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region .
   

  

 What you have
   

  

**Strategic Leadership and Global Partnership**
* India Site Leadership: Establish and lead thinkorswim Technology's first India footprint, including operating model, organization design, and phased scaling plans up to 50 professionals.
* Enterprise Alignment: Serve as the primary India liaison across product, architecture, operations, risk, and compliance teams to ensure clear priorities, transparency, and cross\-functional alignment.
* Technical Domain Representation: Adequately understand and communicate key technical concepts in order management and trading to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Delivery Execution and Operational Excellence**
* End\-to\-End Delivery Ownership: Lead end\-to\-end delivery for specific modules in the TOS ecosystem, ensuring predictability across scope, timeline and quality
* Engineering Excellence: Drive modern SDLC practices, CI/CD discipline, observability, release governance, and reliability engineering for sustainable throughput.
* Risk and Controls: Ensure adherence to security, privacy, regulatory, and audit requirements within a regulated financial\-services environment.


**Talent and Organization Development**
* Talent Strategy: Build, develop, and retain high\-performing engineering leaders and teams; implement hiring, onboarding, and succession strategies.
* Leadership Development: Coach managers and technical leaders; establish clear accountability, performance expectations, and growth pathways.
* Culture and Engagement: Foster an inclusive, high\-accountability culture grounded in collaboration, ownership, and client\-focused outcomes


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 15\+ years of experience in software engineering and technology delivery, including 10\+ years in people leadership roles.
* Demonstrated experience in a large, global Financial Services organization.
* Proven software delivery leadership in highly connected ecosystems with multiple dependencies across platforms and teams.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including executive\-level reporting and influence in a matrixed environment.


**Technical And Domain Qualifications**
* Experience with event\-driven integration patterns such as asynchronous messaging, pub/sub architectures, and inter\-system communication using APIs, queues, or messaging middleware. Java experience is strongly preferred.
* Practical knowledge of distributed systems, including high\-availability design, resiliency patterns, and dependency management across tightly integrated platforms.
* Fundamental understanding of equities and options trading, including order lifecycle, market data, and operational dependencies.
* Experience working in regulated environments where auditability, resiliency, and control effectiveness are critical.


 What’s in it for you
   

  

 At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long\-term financial security.
   

  

**Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include**
* Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more
* Comprehensive medical insurance with Outpatient Department (OPD) services, including vaccination, pharmacy, dental, and vision coverage
* Annual reimbursement for health check\-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees

title: Project Manager (PMO)
description:
**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a Project Manager to own delivery execution across our technology teams. You take the prioritized backlog and make delivery happen planning and tracking the work, running the sprint process, keeping Jira clean, coordinating the people, and acting as the tech team's face to business stakeholders.
 



 This is a pure project management and delivery role. You are the person who keeps everyone aligned, unblocked, and on schedule, and who represents the technical team's status and constraints clearly to the business.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Delivery planning \& tracking** 




 ·      Take the prioritized backlog and turn it into an executable sprint / release plan.
 



 ·      Track progress against timelines, milestones, and commitments; keep delivery on schedule.
 



 ·      Manage risks, dependencies, and blockers proactively surface slippage early with options.
 



  





**Jira \& project tooling management** 




 ·      Own Jira day to day boards, workflows, sprint setup, ticket hygiene, and accurate status.
 



 ·      Ensure every task moves through its states cleanly, and nothing stalls silently.
 



 ·      Maintain dashboards and delivery reports as a single source of truth for status.
 



  





**People \& team management** 




 ·      Coordinate developers and QA across workstreams; manage capacity, allocation, and follow\-ups.
 



 ·      Keep the team unblocked and accountable; drive tasks to completion.
 



 ·      Run the sprint ceremonies planning, stand\-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
 



  





**Stakeholder communication (tech team's face to business)** 




 ·      Represent the technical team to business stakeholders communicate delivery status, timelines, and technical constraints in terms the business can act on.
 



 ·      Manage expectations on scope, timelines, and change; negotiate when capacity is tight.
 



  





**Quality \& release** 




 ·      Ensure testing and release readiness are planned in advance, not left to the last day.
 



 ·      Coordinate deployments and releases with Engineering and QA.
 



  





**Process \& governance** 




 ·      Establish and continuously improve lightweight delivery processes suited to a fast\-moving company.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




 ·      Strong hands\-on experience with Agile and day\-to\-day Jira management.
 



 ·      Proven track record coordinating cross\-functional teams and managing people to deliver on time.
 



 ·      Solid understanding of the software delivery lifecycle enough to hold credible conversations with engineers and QA and to explain constraints to the business.
 



 ·      Excellent written and verbal communication.
 



  





**Core Skills** 




 ·      Delivery planning, scheduling, and tracking.
 



 ·      Jira administration, sprint management, and delivery reporting.
 



 ·      People and team coordination; driving accountability.
 



 ·      Risk, dependency, and blocker management.
 



 ·      Stakeholder management and clear status communication.
 



 ·      Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities.
 



  





**Emotional Intelligence \& Behavioural Competencies** 




  





 ·
 **A two\-way bridge, and a balanced advocate.** 
 You carry the tech team's status and constraints to business stakeholders, and business context back to the team representing both sides fairly. You do not consistently push the pressure onto one side; you find the trade\-off that works for the goal.
 



  





 · 
 **Composed under pressure.**

 As an IT Project Manager at the P3 level, you will own medium\-to\-complex projects end\-to\-end: shaping the business case, driving planning and execution, and delivering measurable outcomes on time and within budget. You will operate with real independence, determining the best path to the objective while partnering closely with business sponsors, technical teams, vendors, and Micron leadership.

**Responsibilities**
**Project Initiation**
* Develop project charters that clearly define objectives, scope, benefits, and success criteria.

* Support vendor selection and partner engagement through scoping conversations and early commercial input.


**Project Planning**
* Establish project governance, including sponsors, core team, and extended project team, and drive effective kickoff activities.
* Facilitate business and technical requirements gathering across functional and technical stakeholder groups.
* Establish and maintain project management artifacts, ensuring a well\-governed and transparent tracking of project progress, risks, and dependencies
* Forecast project spend, SOWs, and POs, and support financial planning and budget tracking throughout the lifecycle.
* Support executive reviews and stage\-gate approvals with decision\-ready materials, not just status updates.


**Project Execution \& Closure**
* Manage project scope, quality, schedule, and deliverables, adapting the plan as new information emerges.
* Track development, SOE, and UAT milestones, and translate progress into clear, decision\-ready status for leadership.
* Proactively manage risks, issues, and escalations by bringing recommendations and options, not just problems.
* Provide consistent and accurate status reporting to PMO and leadership teams.
* Facilitate lessons learned and drive formal project closure and approval.


**Leadership and PMO Excellence**
* Lead cross\-functional project teams and build shared alignment around the project vision.
* Resolve conflicts constructively and manage resource allocation across the project team.
* Provide mentorship to less experienced team members and contribute to continuous improvement in PMO process efficiency.
* Actively adopt AI\-enabled tools and workflows to improve planning, reporting, and delivery efficiency.


**Qualifications \& Skills**
* 5\+ years of Project Management experience, including ownership of medium\-to\-complex, cross\-functional projects.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently under project or sub\-function objectives, determining the best method to deliver rather than requiring step\-by\-step direction.
* Working knowledge of Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall methodologies, applied to fit the project context.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to produce decision\-ready updates for sponsors and leadership.
* Strong change management capabilities and experience facilitating stakeholder alignment without formal authority.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled productivity, reporting, or analytics tools applied to project or portfolio management.
* Experience mentoring junior project team members
* Inclusive, collaborative, and comfortable engaging with technical, non\-technical, vendor, and leadership teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* PMP certification.
* Experience managing enterprise\-wide, cross\-functional programs spanning multiple sites or geographies.


**Education And Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, Project Management, or equivalent certifications/professional experience. Related disciplines considered.
* Minimum of 5 years of project management experience in enterprise technology, infrastructure, security, digital workplace, platform migration, application delivery or related programs


**How Success Is Measured**
 Success in this role is measured through strong delivery against P3 expectations, including independent decision\-making, governance leadership, stakeholder influence, analytical rigor, AI\-enabled PMO excellence, coaching, integrity, and measurable project outcomes.
   

  

**Career Growth**
 Strong, sustained performance against the P3 competency bar, particularly independent decision\-making, governance leadership, and coaching, is the primary pathway to expanded scope and future progression.

description:
Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because
 **Good Health Can’t Wait** 
 .
   

  

 We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.
   

  

 For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).
   

  

 ‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose\-driven, future\-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1\.5 Bn\+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency
   

  

 Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ \& nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**Role Summary:**
 We are seeking an Expert– Projects Design with strong expertise in formulation projects facility design, engineering, and oversee project execution. The role will be responsible for leading the planning, design, engineering, execution, commissioning, qualification, and operational handover of manufacturing facilities while ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
   

  





 The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in Oral Solids, Oral Liquids, Topicals, Sterile Injectables, Aseptic Processing \& Fill\-Finish Facilities along with a proven track record of successfully delivering Greenfield, Brownfield, expansion, and modernization projects.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities**




**1\. Project Planning \& Governance**



* Lead Conceptual, Basic and Detailed Engineering activities for formulation projects.
* Develop facility master plans, site development strategies, project roadmaps, and long\-term manufacturing infrastructure plans.
* Prepare CAPEX estimates, project budgets, business cases, investment proposals, and project schedules \&Manage project scope, cost, timelines, resources, and quality objectives.
* Deliver projects within approved budgets and timelines while maintaining compliance and quality standards.



**2\. Facility Design \& Engineering**



* Design GMP\-compliant manufacturing facilities for OSDs, Oral Liquids, Topicals, Sterile Injectable Manufacturing, Aseptic Processing Facilities \& Fill\-Finish Facilities
* Develop facility concepts, process flow diagrams, block layouts, and detailed facility layouts.
* Optimize material, personnel, equipment, and waste flows to improve operational efficiency and regulatory compliance.
* Review URS, process requirements, engineering deliverables, and design documentation.
* Ensure designs comply with FDA, EU GMP, WHO GMP, ISPE \& local regulatory requirements.



**3\. Greenfield, Brownfield \& Capacity Expansion Projects**



* Lead end\-to\-end project design \& execution from concept development.
* Manage site selection inputs, facility planning, construction, commissioning, qualification.
* Execute modernization projects while minimizing impact on commercial operations.



**4\. Utilities, HVAC \& Cleanroom Systems**



* Design \& review of HVAC, Clean Utility Systems including Purified Water (PW), Water for Injection (WFI), Pure Steam (PS), Clean Compressed Air, Process Gases
* Design review of Black Utility Systems including HVAC Utilities, Boilers, Chillers, Cooling Towers, Air Compressors, Fire Protection Systems, Drain \& Industrial Water Systems
* Ensure compliance with ASME BPE, ISPE guidelines \& pharmaceutical engineering standards.


* Develop facilities up to ISO 5 / Grade A \& ensure environments ensuring pressure cascade philosophies, contamination control strategies, and airflow concepts.



**5\. Equipment Engineering Co\-ordination \& Qualification \& Compliance**



* Equipment selection \& evaluations, procurement, installation \& qualification activities.
* Review equipment layouts, utility requirements, and process integration requirements.
* Support and oversee DQ, IQ, OQ \& PQ activities.


* Ensure facilities comply with FDA, EU, WHO, MHRA \& applicable regulatory expectations.



**6\. Vendor, Contractor \& Stake holder Management**



* Evaluate and select EPC contractors, consultants, and equipment suppliers.
* Review vendor proposals, technical offers, and engineering deliverables.
* Monitor contractor performance, quality compliance, project schedules, and commitments.
* Participate in technical negotiations, and vendor development initiatives.
* Collaborate effectively with Production, QA, Validation, Automation, Engineering, SCM, Procurement, Finance, Regulatory Affairs, and SHE teams.



**7\. Operational Excellence, Automation \& Sustainability**



* Drive value engineering initiatives to optimize CAPEX and OPEX without compromising quality and compliance.
* Identify opportunities to improve facility efficiency, productivity, reliability \& energy performance.
* Support automation, digitalization, and Industry 4\.0 initiatives across manufacturing and utility systems.
* Provide engineering oversight for serialization, packaging automation, AMRs, ASRS, and smart manufacturing solutions.
* Promote Safety\-by\-Design principles and ensure compliance with EHS requirements.
* Participate in risk assessments, HAZOP studies, and sustainability initiatives including energy conservation, water management, and green building practices.
* Drive value engineering initiatives to optimize CAPEX and OPEX.



  

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**




**Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering (B. Tech / B.E.)
   

  





**Experience: 6** 
 \+ years of experience in Greenfield, Brownfield expansions of formulation facility design \& execution.
   

  





**Technical Skills:** 
 Pharmaceutical Facility Design, Facility Master Planning, Utilities \& Infrastructure Engineering, HVAC \& Cleanroom Design, Qualification \& Validation, Automation \& Digitalization, CAPEX Planning \& Cost Control, Risk Management, Engineering Change Management, Contamination Control, Regulatory Compliance, Vendor \& Contractor Management
   

  





**Software Proficiency:** 
 AutoCAD, SAP, MS Project, Microsoft Office
   

  

  

  




**Additional Information**

**Additional Information**




**Global Manufacturing Organisation (GMO)**
  

 At Dr. Reddy's Laboratories, we are dedicated to making a meaningful impact on global healthcare through precision manufacturing and innovation. With a legacy of excellence, we are a leading force in the pharmaceutical industry.
   

  

 We operate 19 state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing plants across Hyderabad, Vizag, Baddi, Mexico, Shreveport, and Mirfield, comprising 8 OSD facilities, 3 Injectables facilities, and 8 API facilities.
   

  

 Benchmarking manufacturing processes and continuous operational excellence are at the core of our capability to deliver quality medicines to our patients in 66 countries. We manufacture a portfolio of complex APIs and 1,150\+ drug master files across key therapy areas such as Oncology, Cardio\-vascular, Central Nervous System and Anti\-Diabetes. he World Economic Forum has recognised our largest manufacturing facility in Bachupally, Hyderabad, as part of its Global Lighthouse Network. We aspire to be the most efficient pharma operations in the world. Our productivity improvement and digitalisation efforts are key to staying competitive, meeting business imperatives, and meeting our ambitious ESG goals. Building such ‘factories of the future’ is integral to innovation and to build healthcare of the future.
   

  





**Benefits Offered**
  

 At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.
   

  

 The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining \& relocation support, family support (Maternity \& Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.
   

  

  

  

**Our Work Culture**
  

 Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.

* Track delivery against scope, schedule and success criteria and flag variances to the Project Manager / Head of Projects early, with proposed corrective actions


**Governance, Toll Gates \& Decision Support**
* Own the toll\-gate evidence pack for assigned projects – tracking TG1/TG2/TG3 artefacts (Transition Acceptance Form, Regulatory \& Client Consent assessment, Tech/IT inventory, KC/KT plan, training sign\-offs, Go\-Live approval) and ensuring evidence is complete, filed and sign\-offs secured on time
* Prepare materials for Tier 2 (weekly tactical) and Tier 3 (operational) governance forums – agendas, status packs, action and decision logs – and facilitate Tier 3 forums for projects you own
* Maintain decision logs capturing what was decided, by whom (Business / Tech / PM), when and why, and follow through on resulting actions
* Contribute to the Tier 1 (monthly strategic oversight) and PMO review packs by consolidating status, risks, escalations and change requests across the portfolio


**Risk, Issue, Dependency \& Action Management**
* Maintain the RAID log (risks, assumptions/actions, issues, dependencies) for assigned projects, categorising by type (business / technical / execution) and impact, and driving owners to closure
* Analyse trends across risks and issues to identify systemic blockers and cross\-project dependencies, and bring them to the Project Manager / Head of Projects with options
* Prepare escalation notes that clearly state the blocker, impact, options and decision required, for use in the appropriate governance tier
* Co\-create mitigation plans with Business Leads, Tech Leads and cross\-functional teams (TA, Academy, IT, Risk, Legal \& Compliance, Control Tower)


**Reporting, KPIs \& Capacity Analytics**
* Produce accurate, insight\-led status reporting – weekly project updates, executive dashboards and the consolidated GCD Projects weekly update – for the Head of Projects, Executive Sponsors and Business / Tech Leads
* Define, collect and analyse project KPIs (timeline adherence, milestone delivery, hiring and onboarding progress, KC/KT scorecards, controlled production results) and turn them into clear recommendations
* Support capacity and headcount reporting – tracking Budget\-to\-Hire, FTE moves across locations and GCD location capacity utilisation in partnership with Control Tower and Workforce Planning
* Build and maintain Power BI / Excel dashboards and reporting templates so that portfolio\-level reporting is consistent, repeatable and largely automated


**Stakeholder Coordination \& Communication**
* Coordinate day\-to\-day with Business Leads, Tech Leads, CD Leads, Transformation Leads and cross\-functional teams across global delivery locations to gather inputs, validate status and close actions
* Maintain living stakeholder maps and RACI for assigned projects, identifying stakeholders that emerge during execution and adjusting engagement accordingly
* Draft clear, concise project communications – kick\-off notes, status updates, change notices, minutes of meetings – appropriate to executive and operational audiences
* Surface business decisions to Business Leads and technical decisions to Tech Leads, while taking execution\-level decisions within the agreed plan independently


**Scope, Change \& Transition Support**
* Support scope discovery and Control Tower intake – helping LoB / BPAs complete intake forms, documenting scope, assumptions and impacted teams, and highlighting overlaps, gaps or conflicts
* Log, assess and track change requests, including impact on timeline, effort and headcount, and route them through the appropriate approval tier
* Track Knowledge Capture / Knowledge Transfer (KC/KT) execution, training completion and access provisioning against plan for transitions from global high\-cost locations to Client Delivery centres
* Prepare Go/No\-Go readiness assessments and support post\-project reviews, capturing lessons learnt and feeding them back into the team's frameworks, checklists and templates


**PMO Frameworks, Tools \& Continuous Improvement**
* Administer and continuously improve the team's project management toolset – Jira boards and workflows, Confluence project spaces, SharePoint evidence libraries and reporting templates
* Maintain the Transition Framework, Transition Checklist, SWAT templates and Transition Acceptance Document templates, incorporating lessons learnt and stakeholder feedback
* Coach Project Officers on tools, templates and governance standards and review the quality of their trackers and reports


**PROFILE**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Operations, Engineering or related field; MBA or equivalent an advantage
* Project management certification such as CAPM / PMP (in progress), PRINCE2 Foundation/Practitioner, Agile / Scrum or Six Sigma Green Belt preferred
* Overall 8\-13 years' experience in back office, BPO or Financial Services domain
* 4\-7 years of project management and execution experience – running projects or workstreams independently in a project, PMO or transition role
* Exposure to transitions, work transfers, process migrations or change programmes in a global delivery / captive centre environment strongly preferred (US/EMEA or multi\-geography stakeholder experience an advantage)


**Technical Skills**
* Advanced Excel (pivots, lookups, data modelling) and Power BI for KPI dashboards and portfolio reporting; strong PowerPoint for executive\-ready status packs
* Hands\-on experience with project management and collaboration tools – Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, MS Teams, MS Project or equivalent planning tools

**Documentation \& Delivery Standards**

* Develop reusable migration use cases, mapping templates, validation checklists, and implementation assets.

* Strong knowledge of GRC, risk management, control frameworks, ISMS, audits, and continuous compliance.
* Knowledge of GDPR, CCPA, and customer data privacy requirements.
* Experience with vulnerability management, penetration testing, incident response, business continuity, disaster recovery, and vendor risk management.

* Ability to work effectively with auditors, engineers, customers, vendors, and executives.

title: Vice President Operations
description:

We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
 **Vice President Operations**
 Lead the operational management and evolution of Domestic Payments, ACH(Automated Clearing House ), RTP(Real time payments) and other Emerging Payments processing within Payments Business Service. The role is accountable for safe, resilient and client\-focused execution, driving end\-to\-end consistency of operational design, efficiency through standardisation and global solutions, and strong risk and control outcomes—while supporting ongoing market infrastructure change and new scheme adoption.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**

* Design, manage and report operational performance using robust MI/KPIs; ensure reporting is accurate, timely and aligned to agreed standards and regulatory expectations. Drive client experience outcomes by reducing client effort and improving transparency (e.g., fewer avoidable rejects/returns, faster resolution of exceptions, clearer status/communications through agreed channels). Lead standardisation and simplification across the functional line, striking the right balance between global consistency and required local/scheme\-specific needs.
* Drive productivity and cost transparency; identify and deliver efficiency opportunities through process redesign, automation and improved workflow/tooling. Ensure all change activities (scheme changes, platform upgrades, new products/rails, regulatory deadlines) are communicated, agreed and deployed with minimal operational disruption. Supervise migrations/transitions where applicable, leveraging existing expertise to shorten transition timelines and stabilise performance post\-move.
* Ensure appropriate risk and control strategies are in place for all processes under remit; proactively identify control gaps and drive sustainable remediation. Manage incidents (including those caused by external factors such as scheme outages or market events) through effective co\-ordination, timely escalation and stakeholder communications. Ensure operational readiness and resilience for evolving payments infrastructure (including new schemes and message format migrations), delivering solutions to mandatory timelines. Partner with Global Businesses, Transformation, Technology and other stakeholders to shape and deliver operational change programmes and innovation across payments workflows. Plan and manage ad\-hoc tasks and senior management queries, ensuring relevant and timely responses.
* Build and lead a high\-performing and engaged payments operations team; set clear direction, expectations and accountability. Retain talent, manage underperformance and attrition, and ensure development and career progression opportunities across payments talent pools. * Promote an inclusive environment that supports diversity and reflects HSBC values; operate effectively across cultures and geographies. Maintain strong working relationships with peer groups and senior managers to co\-ordinate delivery, remove blockers and report progress and results. Contribute to the broader payments governance structure, including policy and decision\-making, through active participation in committees/forums.


**To Be Successful You Will**
* Recognised as a Subject Matter Expert in Payments Business Service / Payments Operations, with strong understanding of domestic clearing, ACH processing, RTP/instant payments and emerging payment rails (including exceptions, returns, rejects and operational controls).
* 10\+ years’ experience in Operations Management, including strong operational control capability and a proven track record in delivery. Strong programme/change/project management skills; able to deliver standardisation, migrations and operational transformation safely. .
* Excellent planning, organising and commercial skills, including strong financial management capability and ability to drive cost transparency. Resourceful and outcome\-focused; able to leverage available resources to achieve goals.
* Prior experience driving innovative operational solutions (process, automation, tooling, MI) is an advantage.
* Ensure employees apply compliance and operational risk controls in accordance with HSBC and regulatory standards and policies, recognising the heightened regulatory implications associated with payments. Continually reassess operational risks inherent in the role, considering changes in economic/market conditions, legal/regulatory requirements, operating procedures, organisational changes and new technology.
* Ensure incidents are reported per the incident escalation process in a timely manner; ensure root cause analysis is completed and corrective actions are implemented and sustained. Support ongoing market infrastructure change programmes (new schemes/rails, rulebook changes, message format migrations), ensuring solutions are delivered to regulatory/mandatory timelines.

title: GPO - Hire to Retire
description:
We are Reckitt
   

  

 Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose.
   

  

 Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
   

  

 Global Business Services
   

  

 Behind our iconic power brands that touch millions of lives daily – from Dettol and Lysol to Durex and Nurofen – lies a dynamic and vital engine: Reckitt's Global Business Services (GBS).
   

  

 Fuelled by a culture of positive energy and co\-creativity \- while learning together \- OneReckitt GBS is at the forefront of our business, driving efficiency, standardisation, and innovation across our global operations. We're a fast\-paced, purposeful team, constantly seeking to optimise our processes, leverage cutting\-edge technology, and deliver exceptional value to every corner of Reckitt. We’re not a traditional back\-office function; we’re a strategic powerhouse where diverse individuals with bright minds come together to solve complex challenges, shape future capabilities, and build a better global business that directly helps achieve Reckitt’s mission.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As the Global Process Owner (GPO) – Hire to Retire (H2R) you will be accountable for shaping and governing the end\-to\-end design, and continuous improvement of the global H2R process landscape. The role ensures standardisation, simplification, scalability, and business\-alignment across the employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition through onboarding, performance, development, mobility, and offboarding.
   

  

 This role sits at the heart of enabling an exceptional employee experience while ensuring operational efficiency, compliance, and alignment with Reckitt’s talent strategy. You will collaborate with HR Centers of Expertise (COEs), Global People Services (Shared Services), IT\&D, and other Global Process Owners in Global business services to drive process design, technology enablement, and continuous improvement across the full hire\-to\-retire value chain.
   

  

 Note: This role is not responsible for running day\-to\-day HR Shared Services operations. Instead, the GPO partners with Global People Services to deliver process improvements, automation, and simplification across all markets, ensuring operational execution aligns with process design and governance standards.
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

* Define and own the global end\-to\-end H2R process strategy, standards, and governance framework
* Lead global design authority for H2R processes including hiring, onboarding, core HR operations, payroll, time \& attendance, and offboarding
* Champion process harmonization and digitization across markets, in partnership with HR, IT, and GBS
* Identify and deliver transformation opportunities that improve employee experience and operational performance
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, policy, and data privacy requirements across the H2R process landscape
* Drive adoption and optimization of H2R platforms (e.g., Workday, ServiceNow, payroll solutions)
* Monitor process performance and drive continuous improvement through KPIs and feedback loops


 The experience we're looking for
   

  

* Deep understanding of the HR function and full employee lifecycle, with extensive experience designing and leading global H2R processes in a multinational company
* Demonstrated success in process transformation, automation, and employee experience enhancement. Proven experience as a H2R GPO or Head of HR Shared Services operations preferred
* Hands\-on experience with global HR technologies (Workday, SuccessFactors, ServiceNow, ATS, payroll systems)
* Experience working in or closely with a Global Business Services or Shared Services model
* Demonstrated expertise in process ownership, transformation, and governance
* Proven ability to influence and align diverse stakeholders across functions and regions
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a data\-driven mindset
* Strong exposure to GBS ramp\-up and mature environments, with a track record of scaling operations and evolving processes
* FMCG or other high\-volume, fast\-paced industry background preferred


 The skills for success
   

  

* Global Process Design
* Hire to Retire
* HR Operations
* HRIS Platforms (e.g., Workday)
* Payroll \& Time Management
* Employee Experience Design
* Process Transformation
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Compliance \& Risk Management
* GBS Collaboration


 What we offer
   

  

 With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way.
   

  

 We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
   

  

 Equality
   

  

 We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: Manager — Incentive Compensation Administration
description:
Join Amgen's Mission of Serving Patients
   

  

 At Amgen, if you feel like you're part of something bigger, it's because you are. Our shared mission \- to serve patients living with serious illnesses \- drives all that we do.
   

  

 Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas \- Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease \- we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science\-based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

 Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role, the Manager, Incentive Compensation Administration will lead the accurate, timely, and compliant administration of field incentive compensation plans and compensation cycles. The role will oversee end\-to\-end IC operations, including data and eligibility validation, crediting and calculation review, payment readiness, reconciliations, exception management, reporting, and post\-payment validation, while ensuring strong quality controls and adherence to approved plan rules and processes.
   

  

 The Manager will lead and develop a team of IC professionals, providing day\-to\-day direction, prioritizing work, reviewing deliverables, resolving complex operational issues, and driving accountability for quality and timelines. The role will serve as a key escalation point for IC administration issues and will identify opportunities to strengthen controls, simplify processes, improve data quality, and increase operational efficiency and scalability.
   

  

 This position reports to a Senior Manager within Field Excellence and partners closely with onshore business stakeholders and cross\-functional teams across Incentive Compensation, Field Effectiveness, data management, analytics, technology, and other supporting functions. The role will also coordinate IC administration projects and key business events—including new plan implementation, annual planning cycles, field realignments, product launches, mid\-cycle changes, and platform enhancements—while maintaining strong governance, documentation, audit readiness, and clear stakeholder communication.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**IC Operations and Delivery Management**
* Manage the accurate and timely administration of assigned field incentive compensation (IC) plans and compensation cycles, in accordance with approved plan rules, established processes, and business timelines.
* Oversee day\-to\-day execution across data intake, eligibility validation, crediting, calculation review, payment\-file preparation, payout coordination, reconciliations, exception management, reporting, and post\-payment validation.
* Review team deliverables and quality\-control results to ensure data accuracy, payment readiness, process adherence, and timely resolution of issues.
* Monitor payout trends, processing timelines, data\-quality issues, field inquiries, and potential outliers; escalate material risks and coordinate appropriate corrective actions.
* Support the operational implementation of new IC plans, realignments, product launches, mid\-cycle changes, annual planning cycles, and system enhancements.


**Team Leadership and Development**
* Lead, coach, and mentor a team of IC professionals, including direct and/or indirect reports; provide guidance on priorities, technical questions, problem resolution, and quality expectations.
* Allocate work, track team capacity and deliverables, and ensure activities are completed within agreed timelines and service\-level expectations.
* Provide performance feedback and support team members’ development in IC processes, data analysis, platform usage, stakeholder communication, and issue resolution.
* Foster a collaborative, accountable, and detail\-oriented working environment focused on operational excellence and continuous improvement.
* Act as an escalation point for complex data issues, calculation questions, field inquiries, and operational challenges.


**Governance, Documentation, and Process Improvement**
* Adherence to IC processes, internal controls, legal guidance, privacy requirements, applicable industry regulations, and audit\-readiness standards.
* Creation, maintenance, and periodic review of SOPs, QC checklists, business\-rule documents, process flows, exception logs, approvals, and records of critical discussions and decisions.
* Identify recurring process gaps, control risks, data\-quality concerns, and manual effort; lead practical improvements to enhance accuracy, timeliness, and scalability.
* Support testing of IC platform enhancements, reports, automation opportunities, and process changes; ensure appropriate documentation and implementation readiness.
* Maintain high standards of confidentiality, documentation quality, and data integrity across IC activities.


**Stakeholder and Project Coordination**
* Partner with onshore business stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams, to clarify requirements, provide status updates, resolve issues, and align on timelines.
* Manage assigned IC administration projects and workstreams using Planner or other project\-management tools; track milestones, dependencies, risks, action items, and delivery status.
* Communicate operational updates, key issues, and plan\-administration insights clearly to internal stakeholders and leadership.
* Support the Senior Manager or functional lead in preparing operational reports, project updates, and materials for key stakeholder discussions.


**Qualifications**
**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree and 5–8 years of experience in incentive compensation administration, sales operations, compensation operations, commercial operations, finance operations, analytics, or a related field.
* Experience leading projects, workstreams, or junior team members in a deadline\-driven operational environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Relevant bio/pharmaceutical, healthcare, consulting, or commercial operations experience.
* Demonstrated experience in field IC administration, including plan implementation, eligibility, crediting, calculation validation, payment processing, reporting, reconciliations, and inquiry resolution.
* Experience coaching, mentoring, reviewing work, or managing direct and/or indirect reports.
* Strong ability to analyze complex data, investigate issues, monitor payout and operational trends, and make practical recommendations.
* Proficiency with industry\-leading incentive compensation administration platforms; experience with reporting, data, and automation tools is preferred.
* Demonstrated ownership, sound judgment, and accountability for team deliverables, issue resolution, risk escalation, and timely completion of commitments.
* Strong organizational, project\-management, problem\-solving, written, verbal, and stakeholder\-communication skills.
* Commitment to accurate execution, strong controls, confidentiality, and continuous process improvement.
* Willingness to be hands\-on on projects
* Good to have IC health checks, plan modeling and design, contest design, goal setting experience

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
The Technical Program Manager (TPM) is HugoHub's internal\-facing role. They own delivery of complex, cross\-functional technical programmes — ensuring the right things are built correctly, on time, and at scale across Engineering, Product, Design, QA, Compliance, and Operations.
   

  

****Who we are looking for****
 We are looking for a TPM who combines deep technical fluency with programme management rigour and the ability to drive alignment across complex, multi\-team organisations. The following qualities define someone who will thrive in this role:
   

  

* Problem\-Solving: Diagnoses root causes quickly, structures options clearly, and drives to a decision — even under ambiguity and time pressure.
* Attention to Detail: Maintains rigour across programme plans, status reports, and technical decisions — because details missed at planning become issues in delivery.
* Programme Ownership: Takes full accountability for programme outcomes. Drives forward proactively without waiting to be asked — and escalates early with context and options, not just problems.
* Time Management: Manages multiple concurrent programmes across teams with different priorities, holding each to its commitments while keeping the broader delivery picture in focus.
* Communication Skills: Translates fluently between engineering reality and business expectation — giving leadership what they need to decide, and giving engineering teams what they need to execute.
* Adaptability: Restructures approach when priorities shift or scope changes — without losing programme momentum or stakeholder confidence.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership: Aligns Engineering, Product, Design, QA, Compliance, and Operations around shared programme goals — driving decisions and clearing blockers across team boundaries without direct authority.
* Technical Translation: Converts engineering constraints, architectural decisions, and technical risks into clear business implications — enabling leadership to make informed, timely decisions.
* Risk and Dependency Management:Identifies risks and dependencies before they become blockers. Builds mitigation plans proactively and communicates trade\-offs clearly to the right stakeholders at the right time.
* Technical Acumen: Understands system architecture, APIs, data pipelines, and the SDLC well enough to spot technical risks, challenge estimates credibly, and earn the trust of engineering teams.


****What a “Technical Programme Manager” means to us****
 The Engine of Cross\-Functional Delivery
   

  

 The TPM is HugoHub's internal delivery engine. They translate strategic objectives into structured, executable programme plans — and then drive those plans to completion across Engineering, Product, Design, QA, Compliance, and Operations. A TPM at HugoHub is not a coordinator. They are a programme owner who holds teams accountable, surfaces risk early, and ensures nothing falls through the gaps between teams.
   

  

****Core Responsibilities include****
 The core responsibilities of the TPM role at HugoHub:
   

  

* Program Planning and Execution: Own end\-to\-end programme planning and execution — from scoping and goal definition through delivery and stabilisation. Define programme goals, success metrics, milestones, and resource requirements in collaboration with Engineering, Product, and leadership. Track progress in Jira using Agile and Scrum methodologies, maintaining a live view of programme health at all times.
* Project Coordination: Serve as the central coordination point across all programme workstreams — ensuring Engineering, Product, Design, QA, Compliance, and Operations are aligned on scope, timelines, and priorities at every stage. Manage risks, dependencies, and blockers proactively; escalate to the right people with context and a clear recommendation.
* Cross\-functional collaboration: Drive alignment across Engineering, Product, Design, QA, Operations, and Compliance — from requirements definition through delivery. Identify blockers, assign ownership, and clear them. Influence and drive decision\-making with senior leadership without direct authority over any of the contributing teams.
* Stakeholder Communication: Own stakeholder communication across all levels — from Engineering sprint updates to leadership steering decks. Produce structured programme status reports (RAG health, milestones, risks, decisions needed). Act as the bridge between business objectives and engineering execution, translating in both directions with precision.
* Technical Oversight: Maintain sufficient technical depth to evaluate architecture decisions, challenge estimates, identify technical risks before they surface in delivery, and engage credibly with engineering teams on design trade\-offs and SDLC constraints.
* Risk Management: Maintain a live risk and dependency register across all programmes. Identify risks early, assess business impact, develop mitigation plans, and communicate trade\-offs to leadership with enough lead time to act — not after the fact.
* Resource Management: Ensure the right engineering and cross\-functional capacity is allocated to each programme. Identify resource constraints early and work with team leads and leadership to resolve them before they affect delivery timelines.
* Quality Assurance: Hold programme deliverables to defined acceptance criteria and quality standards. Coordinate with QA on test planning, exit criteria, and defect prioritisation — ensuring quality is built into the programme, not bolted on at the end.
* Continuous Improvement: Continuously identify and implement improvements to programme management practices, tooling, and ways of working across the TPM function and the broader delivery organisation. Share learnings across programmes.
* Documentation and Reporting: Maintain accurate programme documentation — plans, status reports, risk registers, decision logs, and meeting records. Prepare and present programme updates to senior leadership, translating programme complexity into clear business narrative.
* Mentorship: Coach and develop junior TPMs through structured feedback, shared programme experiences, and deliberate knowledge transfer. Raise the capability of the TPM function as a whole — not just your own programmes.


**What We Consider Relevant Qualifications, Experience And Knowledge**
 The experience and capabilities we look for:
   

  

* 3 to 5 years of hands\-on technical programme management experience, owning complex cross\-functional programmes end\-to\-end
* Background in software engineering or a deeply technical role is strongly preferred — this experience underpins the technical credibility the role requires
* Proven track record of driving cross\-functional programmes to delivery — with measurable outcomes and demonstrable stakeholder management at senior level
* Proficient in English both written and spoken
* Experience in fintech, banking, or regulated technology environments is a strong plus
* Proficiency in Agile and Scrum methodologies; experience running or coordinating sprints across multiple engineering teams
* Proficiency in Jira for programme tracking, dependency management, and reporting
* PMP, SAFe, or PRINCE2 certification is a plus; what matters more is demonstrated delivery at scale


****Performance indicators to get you off to a great start****
**Quick Win — First 30 Days:**
* Map HugoHub's internal team structure, understand each function's role and how they interact in programme delivery
* Learn HugoHub's programme management processes, tooling, and governance frameworks
* Understand HugoHub's product portfolio, active programmes, and client landscape — building context fast enough to contribute to live programmes

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Data
description:
**Aliases** 
**:** 
 Project Manager, Program Manager, Product Manager, Data Operations Lead, Data Delivery Lead, Technical Delivery Lead, or Data Governance Lead.
   

  

**About Truveta**
 Truveta is the world's first health provider\-led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta's ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a unique combination of health, software, and big data expertise who share our company values.
   

  

**This opportunity**
 Join the founding team of the Truveta India Development Center and play a pivotal role in shaping its future. As one of the early employees, you will help build and scale a high\-impact organization while contributing to the products and platforms that advance healthcare through data and AI. This is an unusual chance to influence both the technical direction and the culture of a growing global engineering hub.
   

  

 You will be the program owner for the Data Platform work carried out in India. That means the data\-source onboarding, the processing and quality programs, the governance and access work, and the release and adoption of what the team builds. It is a single, senior, hands\-off\-the\-keyboard role with real accountability and no direct reports.
   

  

**Who We Need**
 We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead complex, cross\-functional programs across data acquisition, data processing, data quality, governance, platform delivery, and data\-product adoption. You will work closely with engineering, data engineering, product, data science, operations, security, compliance, and business stakeholders to convert ambiguous data challenges into clear programs, measurable outcomes, and reliable production capabilities.
   

  

 You will have built systems and we expect you to read an architecture diagram without help, to follow a design review closely enough to ask the question everyone else missed, and to know from experience which risks are worth a week of the team's time and which are not. You will not have formal authority over the teams you depend on, so the job is done through clarity, technical credibility, and follow\-through.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 In this role you will:
   

  

* Own programs from problem definition and planning through delivery, adoption, and post\-launch measurement.
* Build and maintain roadmaps, milestones, dependency maps, risk registers, decision logs, and the delivery mechanisms that keep them useful.
* Partner with engineering and data teams on architecture, technical constraints, sequencing, and delivery risk, at a depth that lets you challenge the plan rather than only record it.
* Coordinate data\-source onboarding, ingestion, transformation, normalization, enrichment, and validation programs.
* Drive resolution of data\-quality issues, operational defects, and recurring pipeline failures, including the root\-cause work that stops them recurring.
* Coordinate data governance, access control, privacy, security, metadata, lineage, and compliance initiatives.
* Identify cross\-team blockers and drive them to resolution without relying on formal authority.
* Facilitate technical reviews and ensure major decisions, trade\-offs, assumptions, and risks are written down where people will find them.
* Coordinate launch readiness, release management, operational support, and post\-launch reviews.
* Prepare clear written updates and recommendations for engineering and business leadership across India and Seattle.
* Improve program management practice, reporting automation, delivery predictability, and operational maturity at the site.


**Required Qualifications**
 The experience requirement is 11\+ years in total, composed of 7\+ years in a hands\-on individual\-contributor technical role and 4\+ years in a technical program or project management role. The two are counted separately and added; a year spent doing both is counted once.
   

  

* At least 11 years of professional experience in total.
* At least 7 years in a hands\-on individual\-contributor in technical roles such as software engineering, quality assurance, data engineering, analytics engineering, systems engineering, or platform engineering.
* At least 4 years in a technical program management or technical project management role, owning delivery across engineering teams.
* Experience delivering programs involving data platforms, data pipelines, data governance, analytics infrastructure, or distributed systems.
* Working knowledge of data ingestion, ETL and ELT, batch and streaming pipelines, APIs, databases, cloud platforms, and data quality.
* Ability to read architecture diagrams and hold a substantive conversation with engineers about designs, trade\-offs, dependencies, and operational risk.
* Experience managing dependencies across multiple teams, driving requirements, delivery plans, risk management, release readiness, and adoption.
* Strong written communication, including executive status reporting and written recommendations that carry out a decision.
* Ability to operate in ambiguity and influencing teams.
* Familiarity with Agile development, release processes, incident management, and production operations.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
 The following skill sets would be good to have:
   

  

* SQL or equivalent data\-querying ability used in practice rather than in principle.
* Hands\-on background with Kafka, Spark, Flink, Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, AWS Glue, or comparable platforms.
* Experience with data governance, metadata, data lineage, access control, privacy, security, or compliance programs.
* Experience with external data suppliers, healthcare data, financial data, or other regulated datasets.
* Experience operating data platforms against measurable uptime, freshness, accuracy, completeness, latency, and cost targets.
* Experience managing distributed programs across India and the United States.
* Experience standing up program management practice at a new site or in a new platform area.
* Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Aha, Linear, Asana, Smartsheet, or equivalent tools.
