 \* RERA Updates: Provide quarterly updates to RERA by coordinating with accounts and technical teams.
 



 \* Customer Engagement: Send wishes to customers on significant occasions like birthdays and anniversaries.
 



 \* Highlighting Positive Customer Feedback: Regularly highlight positive customer experiences and feedback.
 



 \* Interest Collection: Collect interest from customers when payments are delayed.
 



 \* Financial Strategy Development: Create new financial options with bankers, such as ADF (Advance Disbursement Facility) and EMI holidays.
 



 \* Strategic Collection Plans: Develop strategic plans for collections with both existing and new bank teams. \* Banker Approvals: Secure project approvals from bankers as required.
 



 \* Sales Team Meetings: Conduct regular meetings with the sales team to align on goals and strategies.
 



 \* Inventory Oversight: Maintain oversight of inventory management to ensure accuracy and efficiency.
 



 \* Regulatory Updates: Stay informed on updates to interest rates, taxes, stamp duty, and other relevant financial regulations.
 



 \* Team Leadership: Lead, manage, and monitor the team, providing guidance and ensuring they understand all responsibilities and tasks.
 



 \* File Management: Share files and responsibilities within the team on a rotational basis.
 



 \* Target Achievement: Work diligently to meet project targets.
 



 \* Process Improvement: Continuously seek opportunities for process improvements in REALX to enhance efficiency through automation.
 



 \* Social Media Proficiency: Possess knowledge of social media platforms and their use in professional settings.
 



 \* MIS/MIR Reporting: Generate Management Information Systems (MIS) and Management Information Reports (MIR) as needed.
 



 \* Conflict Resolution: Resolve any issues that arise between team members to maintain a cohesive working environment.
 



 \* Recruitment Involvement: Participate in the recruitment process to ensure the team is staffed with qualified and capable individuals. This role demands a high level of organizational skill, attention to detail, and the ability to manage and coordinate across various teams and functions.

title: Project Manager
description:
Job Description
 



**Role Overview** 




 The Project Manager, PMO Operations supports the Program Management Office for one of Astreya's largest dedicated global clients. This is an operations\-focused project management role rather than a traditional delivery project management role. Instead of owning a single project lifecycle, you will keep a portfolio of program actions, initiatives, and workstreams moving across a global, cross\-functional organization, and you will own the communications that keep that organization aligned.
 



  





 You will work across functional groups, driving small to medium initiatives from intake through closure. The role suits a highly organized project manager who is comfortable operating with limited direction, building processes where none exists yet, collaborating between teams, and writing clearly for a senior and global audience.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own tracking and closure of program action items across global delivery teams, maintaining schedules, owners, and due dates, and escalating risks to the Senior Manager before they affect commitments.
* Drive small to medium initiatives end to end, including scoping, planning, stakeholder alignment, status reporting, and formal closure.
* Provide project coordination and communications capacity as needed. This includes building trackers, reporting, meeting cadences, and templates, documenting emerging processes, and taking on whatever coordination work the workstream needs to become self\-sufficient.
* Draft, edit, and publish internal communications across established channels, maintaining a predictable cadence and adapting tone for audiences ranging from frontline delivery teams to senior leadership.
* Coordinate intake and information flow between teams, ensuring requests are routed, tracked, and closed out.
* Produce recurring reports on program health, action status, and initiative progress for senior leadership and client review.
* Identify and implement improvements to PMO processes, templates, and communication practices.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 Six months in, a successful hire is:
 


* Communicating credibly with delivery leads, Account Management, the VMO, and client stakeholders, adjusting register for each audience without needing to be coached on it.
* Raising questions early rather than sitting on ambiguity, including asking the obvious question that nobody else in the room has asked yet.
* Identifying what needs to happen and starting it, rather than waiting to be assigned work.
* Trying an approach, recognizing quickly when it is not working, and changing course openly instead of defending the original plan.



  





**Qualifications and Skills** 



* Bachelor's degree and five or more years of experience in project management within corporate IT, managed services, or a comparable services environment.
* Demonstrated experience in a dedicated or embedded client support model, with sound judgment about client\-facing communication and escalation.
* Experience standing up a new team, function, or workstream, including building the trackers, cadences, and reporting that did not previously exist, and operating effectively while processes are still taking shape.
* Strong business writing ability, with experience drafting communications for a global audience.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively across many different functions and levels, from technical delivery teams to senior leadership and client contacts, and to build working relationships in a matrixed organization.
* Proven ability to prioritize a varied workload independently and meet deadlines in a fast moving environment.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace, AI tools, and work management or project tracking tools.
* Willingness to maintain regular working overlap with US time zones to support global stakeholders.

title: Technical Engagement Lead
description:
The Role
 



 You'll own a portfolio of existing client accounts, reporting to a Sr Account Manager. Your job is to run each engagement — requirements gathered, scope signed off, work delivered, the client's team trained and using it — landing on the committed date and at the quality bar the client expects, every time, while stewarding your accounts' ongoing migrations. You coordinate the analysts and a cross\-functional team on each engagement without reporting lines, and escalate deviations directly to leadership, early.
 



 This role is a designed transition: within two quarters you move into an FDE or AM seat — the landing is decided with the leadership team based on where you've demonstrated the most strength. The move is part of the role's design, not a contingency.
 



 The Bar
 



 Client satisfaction is the top priority for this role, achieved through delivery excellence — project management and technical quality. Every engagement lands on time and at the quality bar clients expect, the client genuinely well taken care of throughout, and the work actually put to use — and the measure is whether the client ends the engagement a promoter: someone who'd recommend Saras unprompted.
 



 What You'll Own
 


1. **Land every engagement on time and at the quality bar clients expect.** 
 No quietly cutting corners to hit a deadline.
2. **Run the full cycle — requirements to sign\-off and adoption.** 
 Gather business requirements, get explicit sign\-off on scope and success criteria, deliver the work, train the client's team to actually use it, and confirm it's being used.
3. **Build a delivery sprint plan that leaves no room for ambiguity.** 
 Every cross\-functional team member knows exactly what success looks like for their task — ownership, success criteria, and dates that mean something.
4. **Keep the client genuinely well taken care of.** 
 Clear communication, no surprises, and the hard conversations handled directly and calmly when something's off track.
5. **Coordinate the analysts and cross\-functional partners on each engagement — without reporting lines.** 
 Catch problems early, remove blockers before they impact deadlines, and escalate deviations directly to leadership the moment a commitment is at risk.
6. **Steward your accounts' ongoing migrations.** 
 Keep them moving on schedule, and keep the client confident through them.



 What Winning Looks Like
 



**First 90 days:** 
 You've picked up the delivery cadence on your accounts, you know the book and the state of every migration cold, and you know exactly where each engagement stands against its committed dates and quality bar.
 



**Steady state:** 
 Every engagement you own lands on the agreed date, at the agreed quality bar, the client can point to it being used, and your clients would recommend Saras — and by the end of quarter two you've demonstrated the strengths that decide your FDE or AM landing.
 



 Who Thrives Here
 



 Any of these backgrounds can get you in the room. Across all of them, you've run multiple full cycles of requirements gathering, sign\-off, and usage.
 


* You've managed technical delivery or implementation projects — data, analytics, software, or systems — from requirements through go\-live, for 5\+ years.
* You're comfortable working hands\-on with SQL, either Tableau or Power BI, or data pipelines — enough to manage the delivery credibly and speak the team's technical language.
* You've held client conversations about scope, value, or renewals — enough commercial footing to see how delivery becomes revenue.
* You've conducted product or platform trainings directly with clients — comfortable being the face of adoption, not just the person who ships the work.



**It's an even stronger fit if you also bring:** 



* Hands\-on experience building AI agents using tools like Claude Code to improve delivery efficiency.
* You've built production\-grade dashboards as React\-native web apps, using AI\-assisted development.
* You hold a PMP, PRINCE2, Certified Scrum Master, or equivalent project\-management credential.
* Experience in pre\-sales at an analytics or consulting firm (2\+ years).

description:
**About Temenos**
**Temenos is a global leader in banking technology. Through our market\-leading core banking suite and best\-in\-class composable solutions, we are modernizing the banking industry. Banks of all sizes utilize our adaptable technology – on\-premises, in the cloud, or as SaaS – to deliver next\-generation services and AI\-enhanced experiences that elevate banking for their customers. **Job Purpose**
 The Workday Integration Specialist is responsible for driving the technical execution of the Temenos Workday Phase 2 implementation.
   

  

 This role focuses on architecting, developing, and deploying complex integrations and custom applications using advanced Workday technologies, while owning the full integration delivery lifecycle across multiple functional areas.

* You will utilize Workday Extend to develop custom applications that enhance and tailor the Workday user experience for Phase 2 business requirements.
* You will leverage Workday Orchestrate to automate complex cross\-platform workflows and manage advanced integration logic.
* You will develop scalable and maintainable integrations using Workday Studio and the Studio Starter Kit.
* You will collaborate closely with functional leads and business stakeholders across multiple Workday modules to ensure technical solutions align with business needs.
* You will configure and maintain Workday security for integrations, including ISUs, ISSGs, security domains, and business process security.
* You will ensure integrations comply with data privacy, security, and compliance standards.
* You will support data extraction and integration logic using Workday reports to enable accurate downstream data consumption.
* You will provide troubleshooting, triage, debugging, and resolution of integration failures during testing phases and hypercare.
* You will maintain integration documentation, technical designs, and deployment artifacts throughout the project lifecycle.
* You will support ongoing integration optimizations and enhancements following implementation.


**Skills**
 Technical Skills
   

  

* You should have 7\+ years of dedicated experience developing Workday Integrations.
* You should have Demonstrated ability to own the complete delivery lifecycle (Design → Build → SIT/UAT → Go\-Live → Hypercare).
* You should have extensive hands\-on experience with Workday Integrations, including multiple full\-cycle implementation projects.
* You should have advanced expertise in Workday Extend and Workday Orchestrate for building custom applications and orchestrated workflows.
* You should have deep proficiency in Workday Studio and the Studio Starter Kit for complex integration development.
* You should have strong experience with Workday Core Connectors, Enterprise Interface Builders, and document transformation.
* You should have advanced proficiency with Workday Web Services, including SOAP and REST APIs, as well as XML, XSLT, and XPath.
* You should have strong experience developing and supporting Workday reports used for inbound and outbound integrations.
* You should have a deep understanding of Workday security architecture as it relates to integration users and data access.
* You should have proven integration experience across Workday HCM, Payroll, Time Tracking, Absence, Compensation, Benefits, Recruiting, Learning, and Reporting modules.
* You should have experience delivering Phase 2 or post\-production Workday implementations involving additional modules or enhancements.
* You should have Workday Certifications in Integrations, Studio, or Extend are highly preferred.


 Interpersonal \& Professional Skills
   

  

* You should have strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* You should have excellent collaboration skills to work effectively with functional consultants, business users, and IT teams.
* You should have strong ownership and accountability for end\-to\-end integration delivery and outcomes.
* You should have well\-developed problem\-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot issues under time\-sensitive conditions.
* You should have strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple integrations and priorities simultaneously.
* You should have a proactive and detail\-oriented approach to quality, testing, and documentation.
* You should have the ability to perform effectively during go\-live and hypercare periods in a fast\-paced environment.

title: Head of SOX Testing
description:
**Company Description** 




 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
 



**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.** 




 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
 



 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
 



**For everyone, everywhere.** 




  





 More about
 **our mission**
 and
 **what we offer**
 .
 



  





**Job Description** 




**About the team (Finance Risk \& Control)** 




 Finance Risk \& Control partners with Finance and the wider business to strengthen the control environment, support SOX compliance, and improve how risks and controls are designed, operated and evidenced. We’re a distributed team across the UK and Estonia, and we’re building a SOX testing hub in Hyderabad to increase consistency, quality and scalability of our testing programme.
 



  





**What you’ll be doing (responsibilities)** 




 Own the SOX business process controls testing programme (end\-to\-end)
 


* Build and run the annual and interim testing plan across all in\-scope business process controls.
* Plan when testing occurs and ensure sequencing reflects process dependencies, change activity, and auditor timelines.
* Deliver both Design Effectiveness and Operating Effectiveness testing to a consistently high standard.



 Methodology, quality, and audit readiness
 


* Own and continuously improve the testing methodology, templates, sampling guidance, and evidence standards.
* Perform QA reviews to ensure testing is complete, well\-documented, and auditor\-ready.
* Ensure consistent conclusions and a strong “why” behind pass/fail outcomes.



 Auditor partnership and external reporting
 


* Be a key interface for the external auditor on business process testing: align approach, share results, coordinate walkthroughs/re\-performance support, and respond to questions efficiently.
* Present testing outcomes clearly in governance packs and formal forums.



 Manage external resources / co\-sourcing
 


* Manage external testing resources: onboarding to Wise methodology, allocation, progress tracking, and quality/performance oversight.
* Ensure external capacity reduces bottlenecks without creating rework or inconsistencies.



 Issue management and remediation governance
 


* Oversee how issues are agreed (severity, impact, root cause) and ensure remediation plans are practical, measurable, and owned.
* Track progress and coordinate re\-testing / closure requirements.



 Minimise burden on the business
 


* Build a low\-friction evidence request process and smart scheduling to reduce disruption for process owners.
* Drive clarity and predictability: stakeholders know what’s needed, when, and why.



 Build the Hyderabad testing capability
 


* This is the first testing hire in Hyderabad; you’ll help build the operating model and then hire/lead a team of 6\+ testers.
* Coach and develop the team; embed standards, consistency, and stakeholder partnership.
* Integrate day\-to\-day delivery with the UK/Estonia Finance Risk \& Control team.



 Innovation: AI/data\-enabled testing in BAU
 


* Identify opportunities to use AI and analytics to improve coverage, speed, and quality (e.g., evidence extraction, population testing, exception flagging).
* Implement in a controlled, explainable way that auditors and internal stakeholders can rely on.



 Themes, insights, and SOX capability\-building
 


* Identify trends across testing results and recommend improvements (control design, execution, monitoring, evidence).
* Help build SOX understanding across the business through guidance, coaching and practical support.



  





**Qualifications** 




**What you’ll bring (requirements)** 




 Essential
 


* Strong SOX/ICFR testing experience across business process controls (DE \+ OE).
* Deep understanding of controls testing methodology, sampling, evidence expectations, and audit standards.
* Proven experience running a testing programme end\-to\-end (planning → fieldwork → QA → issues → reporting).
* Experience managing/coordinating co\-sourced or external testing teams and driving quality.
* Strong stakeholder management and ability to influence remediation outcomes.
* Excellent written documentation skills and governance\-ready communication.



 Nice to have
 


* Experience building/scaling a testing function or controls centre of excellence.
* Fintech/high\-growth/regulated environment experience.
* Experience with continuous controls monitoring, data analytics, or AI\-enabled assurance/testing.
* Experience working across time zones and distributed teams.



 How we work / Level 7 expectations
 


* Sets direction for a programme area and raises the bar for quality and consistency.
* Operates independently, makes sound risk\-based judgments, and escalates early with options.
* Balances rigour with pragmatism—delivers SOX compliance without unnecessary complexity.
* Builds trusted relationships across Finance and the business.



  





 Key stakeholders
 



 Process Owners, Control Owners, Finance teams, Tech/data partners (as needed for automation), External auditors, UK \& Estonia Finance Risk \& Control.
 



  





**Additional Information** 




 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
 



 We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
 



 Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

 Wise.Jobs

 and
 
 Instagram

**Role Summary** 




 Lead the tele\-calling team of 25 Tele callers and supervisors (TL) with focused exclusively on 90\+ DPD accounts, driving resolution and recovery on high\-risk delinquent portfolio through structured calling strategies while ensuring compliance with fair practice norms.
 



  





**Roles and responsibilities:** 




 • Manage daily operations of the tele\-calling team dedicated to 90\+ DPD accounts, driving PTP generation and actual collection/resolution
 



 • Design and refine call scripts and negotiation approaches specific to hardcore delinquency — settlement discussions, restructuring options, and legal\-consequence communication (within compliance)
 



 • Monitor key metrics: PTP conversion%, PTP kept ratio, calls per agent per day
 



 • Identify and flag hardship, willful default, and fraud\-suspect cases; route to appropriate teams (legal/field) per policy
 



 • Conduct call audits to ensure adherence to RBI/MFIN fair practices code — especially around call timing, tone, and no\-harassment norms critical at this delinquency stage
 



 • Coordinate closely with field collection agents/agencies for accounts requiring in\-person visits
 



 • Track and manage settlement/OTS (One Time Settlement) approvals workflow with agent\-wise lead tracking
 



 • Drive agent motivation through contests and incentive structures tailored to high\-difficulty bucket
 



 • Train agents on handling hostile/evasive customers, objection handling, and de\-escalation for this high\-stress bucket
 



 • Prepare MIS/dashboards for senior management: agent\-wise performance, bucket movement trends, PTP funnel analysis, and closure TAT
 



 • Ensure accurate CRM/dialer logging — disposition codes, PTP dates, remarks — for audit trail and legal recourse readiness
 



 • Handle high\-severity escalations and disputes from this delinquency segment
 



  





**Education \& Skill required:** 



* MBA
* Strong grasp of NPA classification, OTS/settlement processes, and MFIN/RBI fair practices code
* Experience managing tele\-calling teams under high\-pressure recovery targets
* Proficient in Excel/MIS (SUMIFS, XLOOKUP, TAT/bucket analysis)
* Strong negotiation, coaching, and crisis\-handling skills
* Familiarity with dialer/CRM systems and legal escalation workflows

title: Engineering Manager — AI Engineering
description:
Engineering Manager \- AI Engineeringneering
   

  

 Location: Hyderabad, India
   

  

 Employment Type: Full\-Time; Salaried
   

  

 Compensation: Base Salary, Bonus, Stock Options, Medical
   

  

**About Innovapptive**
 Innovapptive is an enterprise SaaS company building an AI\-powered Connected Worker Platform for industrial organizations. Our platform connects frontline workers, back\-office systems, and assets in real\-time to drive safety, reliability, and operational productivity.
   

  

 Leading global enterprises including Shell, Hess, Westlake Chemical, Kimberly\-Clark, Scott Miracle\-Gro, and Newmont Mining, rely on Innovapptive to transform how work gets done across plants and field operations.
   

  

 Our customers have achieved $50M\+ EBITDA savings at a single enterprise, 10× improvement in frontline productivity, and 15–20% reductions in maintenance costs.
   

  

 Innovapptive is recognized as a Leader in Frost \& Sullivan's “Frost Radar 2025 \- Augmented Connected Worker Platforms”, with acknowledgments from Gartner and LNS Research, and is backed by Vista Equity Partners and Tiger Global Management.
   

  

 With headquarters in Houston and an engineering center in Hyderabad, we have 300\+ employees across the U.S., India, and ANZ and are on a strong trajectory toward $100M ARR.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 Innovapptive’s Connected Worker Platform is expanding its AI capability from foundational features into a broad portfolio of product\-facing AI agents purpose\-built for industrial field operations. These agents span maintenance planning, work order automation, safety compliance, operator rounds, and knowledge assistance, all grounded in customer\-specific asset data and SOPs.
   

  

 This role leads the AI Engineering team responsible for designing, building, and operating that agent portfolio in production. You own the full lifecycle: from architecture and prompt engineering through evaluation, deployment, and reliability. You work closely with Product, Platform, and customer\-facing teams to translate industrial use cases into AI capabilities that enterprise customers trust.
   

  

 What You Own
   

  

* AI Engineering team across agent development, LLM infrastructure, and model evaluation
* End\-to\-end agent lifecycle: requirements through architecture, build, evaluation, deployment, and production monitoring
* RAG and knowledge infrastructure: document ingestion pipelines, chunking strategies, embedding, vector search, and knowledge graph grounding
* LLM governance: model selection, prompt versioning, bias testing, audit logs, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. All inference within Innovapptive’s AWS VPC — no data to external LLM endpoints
* Agent quality: evaluation frameworks, accuracy benchmarks, hallucination monitoring, and output labelling pipelines
* Sprint delivery and production reliability. Weekly quality scorecard
* Hiring, performance management, and coaching.


 You Must Have
   

  

* 7\+ years in software engineering with 3\+ years managing teams delivering AI/ML or LLM\-powered products in enterprise production
* Hands\-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent) and multi\-step agentic workflows
* Strong grasp of RAG architecture: document pipelines, chunking, embedding, vector databases, re\-ranking, and similarity thresholds
* Experience with managed inference infrastructure: AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, or equivalent
* Track record shipping AI product features on schedule in a SaaS context — not just prototypes or internal tools
* Familiarity with AI observability: prompt tracing, hallucination detection, and output evaluation (Langfuse, Ragas, or equivalent)
* Data\-driven: model evaluation scores, accuracy/recall metrics, agent success rates, and DORA metrics for the team
* Strong engineering standards: prompt discipline, eval\-driven development, responsible AI controls, and production\-grade reliability


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Knowledge graph architectures (AWS Neptune, Neo4j) for grounding agent outputs in structured asset data
* Industrial domain knowledge: EAM, ERP integrations (SAP, Maximo), maintenance workflows, or field operations
* Multi\-agent orchestration patterns: tool calling, agent\-to\-agent delegation, and human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints
* Vision models or multimodal AI: image\-based defect detection, document OCR, or form digitisation
* MLOps and LLMOps: model versioning, A/B evaluation, and continuous prompt optimisation pipelines
* Cloud cost optimisation for LLM workloads: token budgets, model tiering, and caching strategies
* MongoDB and change stream\-based event architectures


 Tech Stack \& Tools
   

  

 AI / ML
   

  

 AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, LiteLLM, LangGraph, Milvus (vector DB), AWS Neptune (knowledge graph), Langfuse
   

  

 Backend
   

  

 Node.js / TypeScript, Python, MongoDB
   

  

 Infrastructure
   

  

 AWS, Docker, GitLab CI/CD
   

  

 Observability
   

  

 Langfuse, Sentry, CloudWatch
   

  

 Tools
   

  

 GitLab, Jira, SonarQube
   

  

 Compensation \& Growth
   

  

 Reports to VP PE\&A. Path to Sr. EM or platform leadership as integration becomes a core horizontal capability.
   

  

 What We Offer
   

  

* Competitive compensation and equity tied to measurable impact on AI accuracy and performance
* A platform to shape the semantic intelligence layer of a category\-defining industrial SaaS company
* Access to cutting\-edge AI, data, and observability toolchains for continuous learning and innovation


 Innovapptive does not accept and will not review unsolicited resumes from search firms.
   

  

 Innovapptive is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or creed, alienage or citizenship status, political affiliation, marital or partnership status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, veteran status, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, childbirth (or related medical conditions), sex, sexual orientation, sexual and other reproductive health decisions, genetic disorder, genetic predisposition, carrier status, military status, familial status, or domestic violence victim status and any other basis protected under federal, state, or local laws

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AI Business Solutions – Dynamics CRM Technical Manager Specialized:**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for a Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Manager to lead large‑scale CRM and Power Platform initiatives, drive technical excellence, and manage high‑performing delivery teams. This role combines strategic oversight, architecture leadership, and people management to deliver scalable, high‑quality solutions that enable business transformation.

* Own end‑to‑end delivery across D365 modules such as Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, and Field Service, with accountability for quality and outcomes.

* Collaborate closely with functional consultants, architects, and business stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Oversee development of custom plugins, workflows, integrations, and extensions using C\#, JavaScript, Dynamics 365 SDK, and Power Platform technologies.
* Establish and enforce development standards through code reviews, design governance, testing strategies, and solution validation.
* Drive solution scalability, security, and performance by overseeing system architecture, integration patterns, and optimization efforts.
* Manage project timelines, budgets, scope, and resource utilization to ensure on‑time and within‑budget delivery.

* Proven experience delivering complex, enterprise‑scale CRM implementations.
* Strong grasp of Agile delivery models, estimation, planning, and governance.

* Canvas Apps and Model\-Driven Apps (Code Apps)
* PCF (PowerApps Component Framework) Controls
* Integrations using Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, and Azure Service Bus

* Dynamics 365 Project Operations
* Dynamics 365 Field Service

**\<\< What we look for\>\>**
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
   

  

 Minimum of 7\+ years of experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM development and implementation, with at least 1 year in a managerial or leadership role.
   

  

 Strong understanding of CRM data models, security, compliance, and enterprise integration patterns.
   

  

 Experience managing budgets, delivery risk, and resource planning for complex programs.
   

  

 Microsoft Dynamics 365 and/or Power Platform certifications are preferred.
   

  

 Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and retain high‑performing technical teams.
   

  

 What we offer you
   

  

 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

title: TPM Leader - GESTC - Hyderabad
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 Key job responsibilities:
   

  

 Enterprise technology delivery strategy
   

  

* Define and execute the technology delivery strategy aligning with Digital delivery leader and in partnership with senior technology stakeholders.
* Establish the delivery operating model, governance structure, decision forums, standards, and escalation paths across the technology organization.
* Define common expectations for planning, milestone management, dependency tracking, risk management, release readiness, and executive reporting.
* Ensure delivery governance is consistent across domains while allowing appropriate flexibility for different products, platforms, infrastructure, data, and cybersecurity initiatives.
* Establish a delivery maturity roadmap covering process, people, technology, tooling, metrics, and organizational capability.
* Translate technology strategy into an actionable portfolio execution model.


 Portfolio leadership and delivery predictability
   

  

* Own the integrated view of the technology portfolio, including scope, milestones, delivery commitments, dependencies, risks, capacity, release timing, and forecast confidence.
* Provide senior leadership with a fact\-based view of portfolio health and emerging delivery constraints.
* Lead portfolio planning and prioritization discussions involving scope, sequencing, capacity, risk, investment, and business outcomes.
* Challenge delivery assumptions and commitments constructively when they are not supported by scope, capacity, technical readiness, or dependency conditions.
* Establish consistent portfolio health metrics and definitions for delivery status, readiness, risk, and confidence.
* Identify systemic delivery constraints and recommend enterprise\-level interventions.
* Ensure material forecast changes are surfaced early with impact analysis and recommended actions.


 Delivery assurance and execution governance
   

  

* Establish independent delivery assurance practices for strategic, complex, and high\-risk initiatives.
* Ensure TPMs maintain integrated delivery plans with clear milestones, ownership, entry criteria, exit criteria, dependencies, and decision points.
* Monitor delivery performance across programs and intervene when risks indicate potential impact to scope, schedule, quality, cost, security, or compliance.
* Lead governance reviews for priority initiatives and ensure actions, decisions, and escalations are documented and closed.
* Ensure delivery teams use evidence\-based forecasting rather than activity\-based status reporting.
* Align product, engineering, quality, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data, and business stakeholders around realistic delivery commitments.


 Dependency, risk, issue, and decision management
   

  

* Establish an integrated approach for identifying, assessing, mitigating, escalating, and closing portfolio\-level risks and dependencies.
* Ensure cross\-domain dependencies across Functional, Data, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Platform, Product, and Engineering teams are visible and actively managed.
* Lead resolution of complex delivery blockers that require senior stakeholder alignment or cross\-organizational intervention.
* Maintain a portfolio\-level RAID and decision management process with clear owners, due dates, mitigation plans, and escalation thresholds.
* Translate technical risks into business, operational, security, compliance, and customer implications.
* Facilitate scenario planning for material risks, including sequencing options, capacity constraints, release impacts, and contingency plans.
* Ensure recurring risks are addressed through structural improvements rather than repeated tactical escalation.


 Release management, operational readiness, and reliability
   

  

* Oversee the Release Management organization and establish an integrated release governance model across products, platforms, infrastructure, data, and cybersecurity.
* Own the enterprise release calendar and ensure conflicts, capacity constraints, environment dependencies, and business impacts are visible.
* Establish release readiness standards covering scope, quality, testing, security, infrastructure, data, operations, support, communications, rollback, and hypercare.
* Coordinate with cybersecurity, privacy, risk, quality, control owners, and business stakeholders on release governance matters.
* Ensure post\-release reviews capture compliance exceptions, residual risks, lessons learned, and improvement actions.
* Ensure go/no\-go decisions are supported by clear readiness evidence, unresolved risks, decision rights, and escalation paths.
* Improve release predictability, deployment reliability, operational readiness, and post\-release performance.
* Ensure significant release incidents are managed through appropriate escalation, root\-cause analysis, corrective action, and executive communication.
* Review release performance trends and sponsor improvement initiatives to reduce recurring deployment issues and late\-stage delivery friction.


 Executive stakeholder engagement
   

  

* Serve as a trusted delivery advisor to the Digital Delivery Leader and senior technology, product, engineering, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data, risk, and business leaders.
* Prepare executive\-ready reporting on portfolio health, delivery confidence, risks, dependencies, releases, compliance readiness, and decisions required.
* Lead senior governance forums and ensure discussions result in clear decisions, accountable owners, and time\-bound actions.
* Communicate difficult delivery information with clarity, transparency, and a focus on options and recommended actions.
* Represent the technology delivery organization in enterprise planning, transformation, risk, release, and operating model discussions.
* Build strong relationships across member firm, global, local geography, and offshore stakeholders.


 Organization design and people leadership
   

  

* Lead and develop a high\-performing organization of Technical Program Managers, Release Managers, and release compliance professionals.
* Establish the appropriate organizational structure, spans of control, role definitions, capability requirements, and succession plans.
* Set clear performance expectations and development objectives for team members reporting directly.
* Hire, retain, coach, and develop talent aligned to current and future technology delivery needs.
* Create career paths, communities of practice, mentoring programs, and knowledge\-sharing mechanisms.
* Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, constructive challenge, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Develop successors and ensure the organization is not dependent on a small number of individuals.


 Delivery metrics and continuous improvement
   

  

* Establish a balanced set of delivery, release, risk, compliance, quality, and organizational health metrics.
* Track trends such as forecast accuracy, milestone predictability, dependency aging, risk aging, release success, approval cycle time, and post\-release issues.
* Use data, retrospectives, stakeholder feedback, and operational results to identify improvement priorities.
* Sponsor improvements to delivery tools, dashboards, reporting automation, governance workflows, and documentation.
* Measure improvement based on business and delivery outcomes rather than process activity alone.
* Establish a recurring maturity assessment and improvement roadmap for the TPM and Release Governance organization.
* Share effective practices across technology domains and scale successful delivery patterns.


 Qualifications:
   

  

 At least one of the following accreditations:
   

  

* Project Management Professional (PMP)
* Six Sigma (Green or Black Belt)
* SAFe certification
* ITIL certification


 Key skills desired
   

  

* 12\+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, Engineering Program Management, technology delivery, product delivery, transformation, or a related discipline.
* 7\+ years of experience leading multi\-disciplinary technology delivery teams or organizations.
* Proven experience leading a multi\-disciplinary technology delivery organization.
* Demonstrated ability to connect technology strategy, portfolio execution, delivery governance, and business outcomes.
* Strong experience leading large\-scale transformation across multiple technology domains.
* Experience with cloud platforms, distributed systems, enterprise data platforms, cybersecurity programs, DevSecOps, or enterprise infrastructure.
* Experience leading platform modernization, cloud transformation, application modernization, or technology operating model transformation.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, Agile, hybrid, and scaled delivery methods.
* Experience improving portfolio predictability, release reliability, delivery transparency, and operational readiness.
* Strong experience managing cross\-functional dependencies, risks, issues, assumptions, decisions, and escalations.
* Experience with portfolio\-level capacity, resource, sequencing, and prioritization decisions.
* Strong executive presence and ability to influence senior stakeholders.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to communicate complex technology, delivery, security, and compliance matters in clear business terms.
* Demonstrated ability to influence across a matrixed organization without relying solely on formal authority.
* Strong organizational design, talent development, coaching, succession planning, and performance management skills.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
****Software Engineering Manager – IBOR****
**What Makes Us, Us**
 Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
   

  

 At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — Caring, Customer success\-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people\-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
   

  

 If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!
   

  

****WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US****
 Product Development is a major part of SimCorp, where software engineering teams work relentlessly towards producing world class solutions. Engineering Managers are leading these teams, and they are key to our success. We are growing and evolving Investment Book of Record (IBOR), a key element in the long standing success of SimCorp and in particular we are expanding the Transactions area to meet increasing client demand and deliver more outcomes.
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
 ▪ First and foremost, you are going to hire and onboard software engineers in Hyderabad, build and nurture engineering teams, thereby be the driver in our quest to scale up our engineering capacity.
   

  

 ▪ You are the leader of 1\-2 teams of Software Engineers with responsibility for growing and upskilling your team through 1:1s, feedback, mentoring, coaching, and goal setting
   

  

 ▪ You have responsibility for both the short\-term deliverables in the sprints and the long\-term improvements of your team(s)
   

  

 ▪ You are responsible for fostering a healthy working environment for your teams
   

  

 ▪ You work closely with your peers in both Engineering Management and Product Management to understand and refine the customer outcomes that you and your teams are responsible for delivering
   

  

 ▪ You collaborate with other leaders to deliver cross area initiatives, and to ensure knowledge sharing and consistency where needed
   

  

 ▪ You understand and define relevant engineering metrics to gain insight into your team’s performance and to help drive improvement
   

  

 ▪ You are responsible for the planning and the delivery of the outcomes of your teams
   

  

**What We Value**
* Experience with engineer recruitment and building engineering teams
* Overall 10\+ years of experience, including:
+ 5\+ years of software engineering experience.
+ 0\-5 years of (people, process, technical) leadership experience.

* Knowledge and experience with AI, with the purpose of improving efficiency
* Experience from a workplace that produces financial software, uses investment management software, has a global workforce, and distributed teams
* Personal accountability and initiative. When something is unclear, you dig in rather than waiting for someone to hand you an answer. You are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, and you follow through.
* Stakeholder management and collaboration across borders.


**Benefits**
 Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work\-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.
   

  

 Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route \- we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.
   

  

**NEXT STEPS**
 Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non\-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
   

  

 If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on a positive growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
   

  

 We are focused on continually improving our talent acquisition process and making everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
   

  

 SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry\-leading, full, front\-to\-back offering for our clients.
   

  

 SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best\-in\-class solutions to our clients.

**Key Responsibilities**
* Independently lead, author or review the clinical development plan including the clinical protocol and study\-related documents viz., pre\-IND, IND, NDA documents for respective clinical sections while working with internal and external stakeholders.

**Required Skills And Experience**
* Minimum of 6\+ years of experience in drug development with extensive experience in Phase 1 clinical pharmacology studies and moderate experience in late phase trials.
* Knowledge in ICH guidelines and GCP and sound understanding of regulatory guidelines and clinical requirements.
* Work experience in 505\.b.2 drug development is preferable.
* Experience in analysis of research data and publications; working knowledge of biostatistics and pharmacokinetics.

title: Program Manager II, Service Delivery Standard Work
description:
**Description**
 At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer\-centric company on earth. Serving over 200M customers globally, our Customer Service (CS) organization is at the forefront of shaping how customers experience Amazon. Our team enables Amazon CS’ frontline teams to deliver seamless, consistent, convenient, and delightful customer service to all our customers across every interaction.
   

  

 We are looking for a Program Manager to join the Service Delivery organization’s associate empowerment team for associate\-facing products. This role is responsible for owning the programmatic charter to support associate\-facing product roadmaps and strategy across multiple Tech teams. You will partner with Tech teams to evaluate and improve existing tooling, define and design the end\-to\-end experience of associate\-facing tools, and test and implement tools and AI capabilities across one of the largest customer service operations globally. You will work backward from associate pain points, define product requirements, and partner with engineering, operations, and stakeholder teams to deliver solutions at scale. You will balance short\-term tactical improvements with long\-term strategic bets to continuously raise the bar on the associate experience.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong product and program management capabilities, business acumen in operations and product sense with deep associate empathy. You are equally comfortable diving into data and anecdotes to identify opportunities, writing narratives for new concepts, and influencing without authority to align cross\-functional teams on a shared vision. You thrive in ambiguity, are biased toward action, and have a track record of delivering programs smoothly, ideally in an operational or technical environment. Disrupting the status quo by challenging mental models, organizational focus, and technology will be part of your day to day.
   

  

 This role can be located in Hyderabad.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own the programmatic charter for Service Delivery for associate and frontline leader facing products
* Contribute to creation of product requirements (PRFAQs, BRDs, user stories) working backward from associates’ needs for both new launches and existing experience improvements. Collaborate with Tech to create operational plans, roadmaps and vision docs for AC3 and Inspire
* Own user acceptance testing (UAT) and incubation management. Define and own success metrics and KPIs; use data to measure launch success and ongoing experience health, informing roadmap prioritization
* Drive framework and mechanisms on AC3 bug/issue management \& resolution
* Evaluate existing associate experiences using data and VoA insights to identify gaps, define improvement opportunities, and prioritize investments
* Partner with Tech, UX design, data science, and operations teams to deliver product features from concept through launch and iteration. Create frameworks to help Tech stakeholders raise the bar on the associate experience.
* Influence and alignment of senior leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders on product direction through compelling narratives and data\-driven recommendations


**About The Team**
 Our global program team owns Standard Work and Associate Empowerment for Amazon Customer Service. Spread across the globe, we support our operations through tooling, frameworks and standard processes that help us deliver consistently amazing customer experiences.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Experience delivering cross functional projects
* Experience working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams
* Experience with product and feature delivery, incl testing and change management


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
* Experience owning technology products
* Experience influencing leadership through data driven insights


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Transformation Program Lead
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different in what we do, how we work, and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

 Your role
   

  

 The Transformation Program Lead is a high\-impact, execution\-focused role at the heart of our operational transformation agenda. Sitting within the Transformation Office, this individual acts as the on\-the\-ground engine of change owing the end\-to\-end delivery of discrete process transformation initiatives, from diagnostic and design through to implementation and BAU handover.
   

  

 This is not a strategy\-only role. We are looking for someone who can think like a consultant and execute like an operator — structuring complex problems with rigor, driving workstreams to resolution, and embedding sustainable change that outlasts their tenure on any given initiative.
   

  

 In this role you will partner with our Global Process Owners, operational teams in our global Client Delivery Centers, Product and Technology, as well as leaders across Client Delivery and in our Lines of Business to define and execute our plans, in a regulated, client\-centric, and compliance\-minded environment.
   

  

**The Ideal Candidate**
 You are organised, analytical, and motivated by tangible outcomes. You are comfortable working through complexity and ambiguity, and you take ownership of your workstreams without needing to be micromanaged. You communicate clearly and confidently with a range of stakeholders, from operations analysts to mid\-senior leadership, and you take pride in delivering work to a high standard. You are eager to grow your program delivery and problem\-solving capabilities, and you thrive in a fast\-paced environment where your contribution is visible and valued.
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

**Program Delivery \& Execution**
* Support the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned transformation workstreams, managing tasks, timelines, milestones, risks, and dependencies
* Develop and maintain detailed workstream plans, ensuring activities are logically sequenced and progressing on track
* Contribute to a culture of accountability and pace, proactively flagging blockers and helping to resolve them
* Maintain thorough documentation of processes, decisions, and outcomes throughout the engagement lifecycle


**Problem\-Solving \& Issue Resolution**
* Apply structured problem\-solving techniques to analyze complex operational challenges — breaking down issues, gathering and interpreting data, and forming clear recommendations
* Proactively identify risks and issues within your workstreams and escalate with proposed mitigations
* Exercise sound judgement to manage competing priorities and maintain delivery momentum


**Stakeholder Management \& Communication**
* Build effective working relationships with business, operations, and technology counterparts across assigned initiatives
* Prepare clear and well\-structured workstream updates, status reports, and risk logs for review by senior program leads and leadership
* Support the facilitation of working group meetings, workshops, and stakeholder sessions, ensuring actions and decisions are captured and followed up


**Team Contribution \& Development**
* Provide day\-to\-day guidance and support to Business Analysts on the team, helping to structure their work and maintain quality standards
* Act as a collaborative and constructive team member, sharing knowledge and contributing to a positive team culture
* Continue to develop your own skills in program delivery, problem structuring, and stakeholder engagement


**Change Management \& BAU Handover**
* Assist in the design and documentation of target operating models, processes, controls, and performance metrics to sustain new ways of working
* Support BAU teams in preparing for handover, contributing to training materials, process documentation, and transition planning
* Participate in structured handover activities at program close, ensuring continuity and a clean transition to business\-as\-usual


**Essential**
 Skills \& Experience Required
   

  

* 5–8 years of professional experience, with a solid track record in program or project management, business analysis, process improvement, or management consulting
* Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver structured workstreams within complex, cross\-functional programs
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills — able to interpret data, identify issues, and develop clear, actionable recommendations
* Good stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience preparing written updates and facilitating working group sessions
* Well\-organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple workstreams concurrently
* A proactive, self\-starting approach with a strong sense of personal ownership and accountability


**Desirable**
* Domain knowledge in one or more of the following:
+ Fund Administration (e.g., NAV production, investor reporting, transfer agency, custody operations, or related middle/back\-office processes)
+ Financial Services Technology (e.g., platforms, system implementations, or digital transformation)
+ AI Enablement (e.g., GenAI adoption, process automation, or AI\-assisted workflows)

* Prior exposure to a Transformation Office or similar centre of excellence
* Familiarity with change management methodologies (e.g., Prosci, Kotter) and/or project management frameworks (e.g., Agile, PRINCE2, PMP)
* Undergraduate degree from a leading institution; postgraduate qualification an advantage


 What we offer
   

  

* A high\-visibility, high\-impact role at the centre of the firm's transformation agenda
* Exposure to a breadth of strategic initiatives across the business
* A clear career pathway into senior transformation leadership, change, or operations roles
* The opportunity to build and shape a best\-in\-class Transformation Office capability
* Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
   

  

**Our Global Benefits Also Include**
* Support for professional accreditations
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location


**Monthly base salary** 
 for this position is from 3,670 EUR to 5,400 EUR gross. Final offer will be determined based on your competencies, qualifications and professional experience
   

  

 Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.
   

  

 (Alter Domus Privacy notice can be reviewed via Alter Domus webpage: https://alterdomus.com/privacy\-notice/)

title: Senior Manager - Control Tower
description:
**Job Title: Senior Manager – Control Tower** 




**Location: Hyderabad** 




  





**About Gamlaa Bioscapes** 




 Gamlaa Bioscapes (https://gamlaa.com/) is India’s leading integrated biophilic solutions company, creating refined, nature\-led environments across workplaces, commercial, hospitality and premium spaces. We combine design, horticulture, execution and long\-term maintenance to transform spaces into living environments that elevate wellbeing and everyday experiences.
 



  





 Our vision is to make biophilic design an essential part of the built environment—creating spaces that are healthier, more human and meaningfully connected to nature. Today, Gamlaa is powered by 1,500\+ people, serving 1,250\+ enterprise clients, delivering 5,800\+ projects and managing 100Mn\+ sq. ft. across India. We’re building a team that brings curiosity, ownership and craftsmanship to breathe life into spaces.
 



  





**Position Summary** 




 The Senior Manager \- Control Tower will lead end\-to\-end project planning, execution, stakeholder coordination, and commercial control to ensure timely, cost\-effective, and quality delivery of projects. The role requires strong leadership across project teams, vendors, internal functions, and customers, with a strong focus on risk mitigation, contract compliance, and operational excellence.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Lead multiple projects from planning to completion while ensuring adherence to scope, timeline, cost, and quality parameters.
* Manage project teams including Project Managers, Engineers, and site execution teams across regions.
* Coordinate with customers, consultants, contractors, vendors, legal teams, and internal stakeholders for smooth project delivery.
* Prepare and review project schedules, resource plans, recovery plans, and progress reports.
* Track project milestones, identify delays, and implement corrective and rescue actions.
* Oversee subcontractor management, vendor coordination, procurement follow\-up, and post\-order execution.
* Handle contract administration, project\-related notices, closure documentation, EOT claims, and cost claims.
* Support warranty, DLP, and O\&M phases as required.
* Review BOQs, estimates, technical specifications, and commercial proposals.
* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, quality standards, and statutory requirements.
* Conduct regular review meetings and present project status, risks, and mitigation plans to leadership.
* Maintain MIS dashboards, documentation, and reporting for all active projects.
* Build strong customer relationships and ensure high levels of client satisfaction.
* Mentor junior project staff and drive cross\-functional collaboration and process improvement.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or equivalent.
* Postgraduate qualification in Project Engineering, Project Management, or Construction Management preferred.
* Strong background in project execution, planning, and site coordination.
* Required Experience
* 8–12\+ years of experience in project management, planning, and execution.
* Proven experience in leading multi\-location or multi\-project operations.
* Strong exposure to project planning, subcontractor management, billing, vendor management, and contract administration.
* Experience in handling EOT, claims, recovery planning, and stakeholder negotiations.



**Desired Skills** 



* Project planning and scheduling.
* Cross\-functional coordination.
* Contract management and claim handling.
* Vendor and subcontractor management.
* Resource forecasting and allocation.
* Cost control and budget tracking.
* Risk assessment and mitigation.
* MIS reporting and documentation.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and leadership skills.
* Working knowledge of Primavera P6, SAP, and project reporting tools.

title: Business Systems Analysis Senior Associate
description:
Are you ready to explore a world of possibilities?
   

  

 Join our DTCC family, and you’ll grow your expertise and become the best version of you. As you embark on a new journey, you’ll seek challenges with flexibility and patience, learning new skills and advancing your career while having the time of your life.
   

  

**Why You Love This Job**
 You will be part of the Enterprise Product \& Platform Engineering (EPPE) organization, responsible for providing centralized, independent infrastructure testing and quality assurance services. This role focuses on driving infrastructure testing delivery, governance, and coordination across projects, ensuring improved system stability, compliance, and release readiness.
   

  

 The Lead Business Systems Analyst will act as a delivery lead/project coordinator for infrastructure testing, managing backlog execution, prioritization, stakeholder communication, and reporting.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities**
 Infrastructure Testing Delivery \& Coordination
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end infrastructure testing delivery across multiple concurrent programs and releases
* Coordinate testing activities aligned with application and infrastructure release plans
* Act as the primary liaison between Infrastructure Engineering, Application Teams, and Test teams
* Ensure test readiness across environments (build validation, baseline validation, integration readiness)
* Track and manage dependencies, risks, and testing milestones


 Agile Delivery \& Work Management
   

  

* Drive JIRA\-based Agile delivery (Scrum/Kanban) including backlog refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization
* Manage and monitor story progress, defect tracking, and test execution status
* Ensure clear definition of acceptance criteria, test scope, and Definition of Done (DoD)
* Facilitate daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and stakeholder updates
* Optimize workflow efficiency and reduce delivery bottlenecks


 Resource Planning \& Workload Management
   

  

* Plan and allocate resources based on priority, complexity, and delivery timelines
* Monitor utilization across onshore/offshore teams
* Balance competing priorities across multiple initiatives
* Identify capacity gaps and escalate proactively


 Metrics, Reporting \& Leadership Communication
   

  

* Prepare executive\-level dashboards, metrics, and status reports
* Provide insights on: \- Test coverage
* Automation progress
* Defects and quality trends
* Delivery risks and timelines
* Present program updates to Director\-level and senior stakeholders
* Drive data\-driven decision\-making using tools such as Power BI / dashboards


 Process, Governance \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Ensure adherence to EPPE testing standards, governance, and audit requirements
* Identify process gaps and drive improvements through automation and standardization
* Implement controls for traceability, test coverage, and compliance validation
* Support audit readiness and documentation standards


 Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Collaborate with Product Management, Infrastructure Engineering, Application Development teams
* Communicate risks, blockers, and status clearly and proactively
* Influence outcomes without direct authority


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related discipline (or equivalent experience)


 Talents Needed for Success
   

  

* 8\+ years of experience in Business Systems Analysis, Infrastructure Testing, or Delivery/Program Coordination roles
* Familiarity with tools such as ServiceNow, Power BI, automation pipelines
* Strong experience in Agile delivery models (Scrum/Kanban)
* Hands\-on experience with JIRA (backlog, workflows, reporting)
* Experience working in infrastructure or platform environments (cloud/on\-prem)
* Strong understanding of risk, compliance, and audit expectations
* Proactively identifies and mitigates delivery risks
* Good understanding of the role of automation in various SDLCs (e.g. agile, scrum, waterfall) and mentor, train and coach resources.
* Ability to work on multiple work streams concurrently in a fast\-paced environment with extreme multi\-tasking and context switching.

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Senior, Tax Services**
 Join Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited and help clients improve cross\-border trade operations through Oracle Global Trade Management (GTM) solutions. This role focuses on leading end\-to\-end GTM programs, including solution design, compliance controls, integrations, and governance. You will help translate global trade policy into scalable Oracle GTM configurations, workflows, and operating processes that support compliant and efficient trade execution. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, compliance, and business transformation in a complex global environment.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Senior, Tax Services on the Oracle Global Trade Management (GTM) team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Own the Oracle GTM workstream across discovery, design, build, test, deploy, and hypercare, and manage day\-to\-day priorities, dependencies, delivery quality, scope, RAID, estimates, and status reporting.
* Define end\-to\-end trade architecture across Oracle GTM and connected enterprise systems, and translate policy and regulatory requirements into enforceable controls, workflows, and audit\-ready traceability.
* Lead Oracle GTM solution design and oversight across restricted party screening, sanctions and export controls, classification, origin, valuation, license management, free trade agreement and preference programs, documentation, landed cost, and exception handling.
* Lead integration design, trade master data governance, reconciliation, monitoring, and control evidence across ERP, OMS, WMS, TMS, PIM, PLM, and external providers.
* Own testing strategy, user acceptance testing, cutover planning, hypercare, training materials, operating model design, governance cadence, and KPI alignment.


**The team**
 Deloitte’s Oracle and global trade transformation teams help organizations improve trade compliance, customs readiness, and cross\-border operations through technology\-enabled solutions. The team works across compliance, supply chain, finance, legal, and technology stakeholders to design scalable operating models, controls, and integrations that support accuracy, efficiency, and auditability. Professionals in this area support complex transformation programs involving Oracle GTM, connected enterprise platforms, data governance, and regulatory requirements across multiple jurisdictions.
   

  

**Location: Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune**
**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* 8\-12\+ years of experience in global trade or compliance technology delivery, including 3\-6\+ years in Oracle Global Trade Management implementation leadership.
* Experience leading at least one full lifecycle Oracle Global Trade Management implementation or major transformation.
* Experience with restricted party screening, sanctions or embargo controls, import or export compliance, export controls, Harmonized System or Harmonized Tariff Schedule classification, country of origin, valuation, licensing controls, or free trade agreement and preference concepts.
* Experience translating legal or compliance policy into system rules, workflows, and measurable controls.
* Experience with estimates, RAID management, quality gates, and executive\-ready status communication.
* Experience with integration design across APIs, flat files, middleware, mapping, error handling, monitoring, and reconciliation.
* Experience leading data migration, data conversion, and validation activities.


 Preferred:
   

  

* Working knowledge of Oracle ERP, supply chain management, Oracle Transportation Management, or Oracle Integration Cloud.
* SQL or data analysis capability.
* Experience with broker or filing provider integrations and customs data handoff patterns.
* Experience building global templates with localized compliance extensions.
* Experience supporting audit requirements, control evidence, and traceability.
* Prior consulting lead experience across multi\-client or multi\-program delivery.


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. **Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. * Serve as the Support teams point of contact for integration issues to speed the resolution time
