* Act as a bridge to Product Management for technical enhancement request discussions \& prioritization
* Bring market, customer, and competitive insights back to Product and Services leadership to influence roadmap discussions, improve delivery offerings, and strengthen customer value propositions.
* Work in a very international environment and closely with at times offshore engineering teams, providing requirements in the development of integration solutions.
* Manage and expand relationships “high and wide” in customer organisations to expand the relationship footprint
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure excellent service delivery, high\-quality deliverables, positive customer experience, value realisation, and strong referenceability.
* Participate in Partner oversight on specific projects to ensure alignment to best practices, as well as guide partners to ensure the best interest of the customer is being considered.
* Maintain product and technical certifications
* Support internal initiatives that improve Services productivity, operating model maturity, AI adoption, product readiness, customer value realisation, and revenue growth.
* Coach junior members of the team as well as other teams within the business
* Write detailed knowledge management articles to support new functionality and capability
* Actively seek opportunities to grow and develop the operational aspects of the role
* Become a trusted advisor \- seeks to develop internal teams and other areas of the business through sharing of knowledge



  





**You’ve got what it takes if you have...** 



* 8\+ years relevant experience in the HCM space, with more than 5 years of technical consulting / project management experience working with enterprise customers (less experience considered if previous Cornerstone integration knowledge)
* Experience working in, or closely with, a product\-based SaaS company Services function, with an understanding of how Professional Services contributes to adoption, expansion, retention, customer success, and revenue outcomes.
* Strong technical background, with experience identifying solutions that integrate Enterprise applications, SaaS or other complex services.
* Strong AI awareness and mindset, including the ability to identify practical AI, automation, analytics, and knowledge\-management use cases that improve delivery efficiency, quality, scalability, and customer outcomes.
* Experience with software integrations and data migrations, preferably with Cornerstone products, as a consultant or project lead.
* Hands\-on experience leading or supporting enterprise\-scale migration programmes, including platform migrations, product\-to\-product transitions, data migration, integration migration, and customer environment readiness.
* Strong understanding of migration strategy, planning, discovery, data assessment, mapping, validation, cutover, hypercare, and post\-migration stabilisation activities in complex customer environments.
* Ability to evaluate migration complexity, dependencies, risks, assumptions, technical constraints, and customer readiness, and convert these into practical delivery plans, mitigation actions, and stakeholder communications.
* Experience partnering with Product, Engineering, Services, Customer Success, Sales, Partners, and customer stakeholders to align migration execution with product capabilities, roadmap readiness, business priorities, time to value, and revenue impact.
* Proven ability to drive migration outcomes beyond technical completion, including adoption readiness, customer confidence, reduced disruption, accelerated value realisation, and successful transition to steady\-state support.
* Proven experience defining, designing, delivering and configuring software interfaces between multiple systems (EDI)
* Proven experience in Business User Data (T\&A / HCM / LMS). Ability to critically evaluate and analyse Data
* Experience in delivering strategic guidance in line with product release map, and driving customer system improvements
* Business and market knowledge with the ability to connect technical recommendations to customer priorities, product adoption, operational efficiency, time to value, and revenue impact.
* Experience in successfully managing customer escalations, or working collaboratively, supporting Partner (Supplier) Integrations with Cornerstone. Maturity of thinking when engaged in highly political or stressful situations
* Experience in process design, research and competitive analysis, package implementation, knowledge of multiple technologies and interactive design.
* Exceptionally strong leadership, interpersonal and communication skills to effectively manage customer project stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams.
* Outcome\-oriented consulting mindset with proven ability to manage delivery trade\-offs, influence stakeholders, drive decisions, and align execution to customer satisfaction, value realisation, and commercial objectives.
* Expertise in one or more industries, organisational structures, business process design techniques and development methodologies.

title: Alpha Business Process Engineer, Officer

**Who We Are Looking For**
 We are seeking a hands\-on process and knowledge engineer to join Alpha Intelligence, State Street’s AI \& Automation Center of Excellence for Alpha Implementations. You will help transform complex processes end to end — understanding how work is done today, designing simpler future\-state processes, and enabling automation and AI solutions that improve speed, control and client outcomes.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is analytical, structured and delivery\-focused, comfortable working directly with subject\-matter experts, and able to own a workstream of process discovery and documentation end to end with limited supervision.
   

  

**Why this role is important to us**
 Alpha Intelligence goes beyond documenting processes — we redesign how Alpha implementations are delivered. This role connects process discovery, future\-state design, automation and AI, implementation and continuous improvement.
   

  

**About The Team — Alpha Intelligence**
 Alpha Intelligence is State Street’s AI \& Automation Center of Excellence for Alpha Implementations — the team rewiring how the industry’s first front\-to\-back platform gets delivered. We turn the deep expertise locked inside our implementation teams into engineered processes, governed knowledge and intelligent agents that cut manual effort, compress client go\-live timelines and make every implementation faster and more predictable than the last.
   

  

 We operate as one global team across the US, UK, Europe, India and APAC, combining process engineering, automation delivery, AI platform engineering and responsible\-AI governance under a single roof. We work on real client implementations, not pilots that sit on a shelf — what we build is adopted, measured and scaled. If you want to shape how AI is applied to one of the most complex delivery landscapes in financial services, this is the team to do it in.
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
* Conduct process discovery through interviews, shadowing, walkthroughs and system observation with implementation and operations subject\-matter experts.
* Own end\-to\-end process transformation for assigned workstreams, from discovery and future\-state design through implementation, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Map and assess current\-state processes, including handoffs, systems, data, controls and exceptions, to identify root causes, effort, risk and friction.
* Design simpler, standardized future\-state processes that improve controls and use the right mix of people, process, data, automation and AI.
* Structure and tag content for search, RAG and agent use, ensuring knowledge assets are discoverable, accurate and maintainable.
* Validate process and knowledge assets with subject\-matter experts, manage signoffs and maintain version control.
* Prioritize redesign, automation and AI opportunities, and define the expected benefits and success measures.
* Turn approved future\-state designs into clear requirements and implementation plans, working with automation, AI, technology, operations and change teams.
* Support rollout and adoption, track results, and use feedback to improve the process over time.
* Maintain accurate status, progress and delivery reporting for your assigned workstream, escalating risks and blockers early.
* Coordinate across regional teams and time zones to enable seamless handoffs and effective dependency management.


**What We Value**
* Strong structured thinking and attention to detail — precision matters in process and knowledge engineering.
* Curiosity and persistence in getting to the real process, not just the documented one.
* Self\-driven delivery with the ability to produce quality outcomes with minimal follow\-up.
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication, especially in documentation.
* A collaborative mindset and comfort working with senior subject\-matter experts and global stakeholders.


**Experience And Capabilities That Will Help You Succeed**
* 10 to 15 years of relevant experience in business process analysis, process documentation, operations, transformation or automation delivery within financial services.
* Working knowledge of investment management or capital markets operations across front, middle and back office and the trade lifecycle.
* Hands\-on experience with process mapping and documentation methods and tools, exposure to BPMN, Visio, UiPath Task Capture, ARIS or comparable platforms is beneficial.
* Familiarity with automation platforms such as UiPath and an understanding of what makes a process automatable.
* Good understanding of AI and GenAI concepts, including how structured knowledge and content quality drive RAG and agent performance.

title: Operations Associate/Account Manager
description:

 We are among India's largest education consulting companies, serving over 4000 customers annually from over 19 countries. We operate as a mentorship platform that brings students aiming to pursue their master's degrees abroad in touch with current or past students at top universities all over the world.
 



  





 Applying for a master's degree at foreign universities can be a daunting process. Gradvine's mentors ensure students have access to well\-informed and unbiased advice while writing their essays and shortlisting universities for their profiles.
 



  





 In the last 6 years, we've mentored close to 10,000 students to the Ivy League and other top universities in the U.S., Canada, and Europe through our mentor network of 1200 students and professionals at the top universities and companies in the world. Our top admits include Stanford, MIT, The University of Pennsylvania, UC Berkeley, CMU, Dartmouth College, Duke, Purdue, Georgia Tech, University of British Columbia, Columbia and many more.

 Full\-time \| Hyderabad, Telangana (On\-site)

This team ensures that the company remains operationally efficient while coordinating between our brilliant mentors and customers.
 



  





 The Account Manager will handle the end\-to\-end process for each one of the students that subscribe to our Undergraduate and Masters service offerings. This includes working with individual stakeholders \- Mentors, University selection team, students, and parents \- on the application process.
 



  





 The work is demanding and will require dedication to the company and client. title: R&D Engineering, Director
description:
We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You have spent two decades building embedded memory IP that actually ships in products, not just passes tape\-out reviews, and you know the difference between a circuit that works in simulation and one that survives process variation at 3nm. Leading teams is not about org charts for you, it is about knowing when to step into a schematic review because the bit cell leakage numbers do not add up, and when to step back because your engineer has the answer but needs space to find it.
   

  

 You think in full flows. Architecture decisions ripple into layout constraints, layout choices show up in characterization data, and characterization data feeds back into compiler automation. You have debugged enough memory compiler issues to know that the problem is rarely where it first appears, and you ask the kind of questions that get to root cause without wasting three days.
   

  

 Managing multiple projects across FinFET nodes does not rattle you. You prioritize without drama, communicate blockers before they become crises, and keep your team focused on what actually moves the schedule. When a customer escalates a timing model issue, you do not deflect, you own it, pull in the right people, and drive it closed.
   

  

 At Synopsys, you will lead a team that builds the memory IP behind the semiconductors powering AI, automotive, and mobile products worldwide.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Lead a team of memory design engineers developing SRAM, Register File, TCAM, and ROM architectures and circuit implementations for advanced process nodes including FinFET
* Own the full memory design flow from bit cell analysis and architecture through schematic entry, simulation, layout planning, characterization, verification, and model generation
* Drive low\-power, area\-efficient embedded memory circuit design and supervise layout activities, interfacing directly with CAD teams on verification and compiler automation
* Manage project timelines, prioritize tasks across multiple concurrent projects, and resolve technical and scheduling issues proactively to ensure on\-time delivery
* Build and maintain relationships with cross\-functional teams including characterization, verification, and customer\-facing engineering to align on deliverables and resolve escalations
* Apply and expand expertise in memory compiler development, transistor\-level circuit design, and variation\-aware design techniques for deep submicron technologies
* Mentor engineers, facilitate technical problem\-solving, and foster collaboration across multi\-site teams in Hyderabad and globally


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Deliver embedded memory IP that powers leading\-edge semiconductor products across AI, automotive, mobile, and high\-performance computing markets
* Enable Synopsys customers to meet aggressive area, power, and performance targets by providing robust, scalable memory solutions that work in silicon
* Reduce time\-to\-market for memory compiler releases by streamlining design flows, improving automation, and catching issues earlier in the development cycle
* Strengthen Synopsys reputation as a trusted memory IP partner by resolving customer escalations quickly and delivering high\-quality timing and power models
* Build a high\-performing team culture where engineers grow technically, take ownership, and consistently deliver complex projects on schedule
* Drive process improvements that increase team productivity, reduce characterization cycles, and improve compiler quality metrics
* Shape the technical direction of embedded memory IP development at Synopsys by contributing expertise in advanced node challenges and circuit innovation


 What You'll Need
   

  

* BE/B.Tech/ME/M.Tech/MS in Electrical and Electronics Engineering from a recognized university
* 20\+ years of hands\-on experience in embedded memory design including SRAM, Register File, TCAM, and ROM architecture and circuit implementation
* Deep expertise across the full memory design flow: architecture, schematic design, layout planning, characterization, timing analysis, and model generation
* Proven experience leading and managing engineering teams, delivering complex projects on schedule, and resolving technical and project issues across multiple priorities
* Strong proficiency in transistor\-level circuit design for deep submicron and FinFET technologies, including variation\-aware design techniques
* Mastery of Perl and Python for design automation and scripting
* Experience with memory compiler development and automation is a strong plus


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can walk into a schematic review, spot a leakage path or timing violation in minutes, and explain the fix in a way that helps the engineer learn, not just comply
* When a project is slipping, you do not wait for the weekly status meeting, you pull the team together, identify the real blocker, and adjust the plan that day
* You know how to say no to a customer request that will derail the schedule without burning the relationship, and you can explain the tradeoff in terms they actually care about
* Debugging a characterization mismatch across process corners does not frustrate you, it engages you, because you know the answer is in the data and you will find it
* You build trust by doing what you say you will do, owning mistakes when they happen, and giving your team credit when things go right
* You are comfortable working across time zones and geographies, and you adapt your communication style to make sure nothing gets lost in translation


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 You will lead a team within the Embedded Memory and Logic group at Synopsys, part of the Solutions Group. This team is responsible for developing standard and custom embedded SRAMs, ROMs, and TCAMs, delivering both functional and physical memory views through advanced memory compilers. The team covers the full spectrum of memory IP development, from bit cell analysis and architecture design to characterization, verification, and model generation. Your team will work closely with CAD, verification, and customer\-facing engineering teams across Synopsys global sites to deliver memory IP that enables the design of complex integrated circuits for leading\-edge semiconductor products.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: Manager, Channel Operations – Contracts & Pricing Execution (AIN)
description:
**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
 At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
   

  

 Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 As the Manager, Channel Operations – Contracts \& Pricing Execution (AIN), you will lead AIN\-based execution of U.S. Channel operations within the Contracts \& Pricing Execution function. This role is responsible for managing Channel Payments, Channel Analytics, contract update processing, CDP maintenance, GCPS administration, scorecard validation, payment package governance, product launch support, operational controls, reconciliations, reporting, documentation, and continuous improvement activities.
   

  

 Reporting to the Senior Manager/Director, Contracts \& Pricing Execution, you will partner closely with ATO Channel SMEs, National Account Managers, Pricing, Market Access, Trade Operations, Finance, Information Systems, Commercial Operations, and AIN cross\-functional teams to ensure accurate, compliant, scalable, and audit\-ready Channel execution. The role will lead AIN Associates and Analysts to support Channel operations while preserving appropriate ATO oversight for strategic decisions, complex contract interpretation, customer\-facing engagement, approvals, and risk management.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
*Channel Operations Leadership*
* Lead end\-to\-end execution of Channel operations including contract update processing, CDP management, GCPS administration, scorecard generation, payment processing, waiver governance, analytics support, reconciliations, and payment package readiness.
* Manage workloads, operational calendars, payment cycles, quarter\-close deliverables, issue inventories, exception management, and execution readiness across Channel processes.
* Ensure repeatable and scalable execution of standard\-state activities transitioning to AIN while maintaining proper escalation pathways for complex decisions and approval requirements.
* Establish operational discipline through KPI management, workload balancing, service expectations, quality reviews, readiness gates, and issue escalation frameworks.


*CDP, Contract \& GCPS Governance*
* Oversee Monthly and Quarterly CDP Update processes, Conga review activities, contract amendment assessments, and operational implementation of approved contract changes.
* Lead GCPS setup, maintenance, strategy updates, tracker governance, and program configuration activities.
* Ensure CDP\-to\-GCPS alignment, execution quality, peer\-review effectiveness, and appropriate documentation retention.
* Partner with NAMs and retained ATO stakeholders on contract interpretation, amendment impact assessments, and complex operational decisions.


*Payments, Validation \& Financial Controls*
* Oversee scorecard generation, DOH validation, net sales reconciliation, payment package readiness, waiver processing, and payment calculation activities.
* Lead review of performance reports, scorecards, payment packages, trend reporting, and reconciliation outputs.
* Ensure SOX\-aligned controls, documentation standards, review evidence, decision logs, and audit readiness requirements are consistently maintained.
* Drive operational governance across payment approvals, exception resolution, reconciliation reviews, and control execution.


*Analytics, Reporting \& Operational Insights*
* Lead Channel analytics support including net sales reconciliations, inventory reporting, compliance reporting, DOH analysis, 852/867 validation activities, and operational dashboards.
* Review variances, trends, recurring exceptions, payment drivers, and operational metrics to improve execution quality and transparency.
* Ensure reporting outputs support decision\-making, payment approvals, audit requirements, and operational planning activities.
* Drive reporting standardization, KPI adoption, and analytics maturity across the Channel organization.


*Product Launch \& Continuous Improvement*
* Oversee AIN execution support for product launch readiness, MMDS activities, approved WAC maintenance activities, master data coordination, and launch documentation governance.
* Partner with ATO launch SMEs on transition planning, launch support activities, SOX documentation requirements, and process readiness.
* Drive automation, simplification, AI\-enabled opportunities, reporting improvements, issue reduction initiatives, and workflow optimization.
* Support system enhancements, UAT execution, defect management, access readiness, and digital transformation initiatives across Channel operations.


*People Leadership \& Transition Readiness*
* Lead, coach, and develop AIN\-based Medicaid Associates / Senior Associates supporting Medicaid operations and transition execution.
* Build a structured onboarding and KT model across learning, shadowing, reverse shadowing, supervised execution, and readiness sign\-off before independent ownership expands.
* Partner with ATO Medicaid SMEs to define skills, proficiency levels, QA standards, escalation rules, and readiness criteria for each Medicaid process step.
* Create a culture of accountability, compliance, quality, continuous improvement, stakeholder service, and One CPE collaboration across ATO and AIN.


*Compliance, Controls \& Audit Readiness*
* Ensure compliance with SOX controls, internal policies, pricing governance requirements, audit standards, and applicable pharmaceutical contracting regulations
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation, approval evidence, decision logs, dispute records, and process workpapers supporting operational compliance.
* Identify operational, compliance, financial, and data integrity risks and lead mitigation and remediation efforts.
* Support internal, external, and SOX audit activities and drive closure of audit observations.


**What We Expect Of You**
 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The ideal candidate is a strong Medicaid / managed markets operations leader with experience in U.S. healthcare or pharmaceutical rebate operations, financial controls, systems enablement, and people leadership. This individual combines operational discipline, Medicaid domain knowledge, analytical rigor, stakeholder collaboration, and a continuous improvement mindset to build a scalable AIN Medicaid capability.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, Economics, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Engineering, Analytics, or related discipline.
* 8 to 13 years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, Gross\-to\-Net, Channel operations, revenue management, contract operations, commercial finance, analytics, or related areas.
* 3\+ years of experience leading people, operational teams, or complex cross\-functional delivery.
* Experience partnering with U.S.\-based stakeholders across Finance, Market Access, Pricing, Contracting, Commercial Operations, Compliance, IT, or Revenue Management organizations.
* Experience leading process execution, reporting, controls, documentation, reconciliations, or operational transformation initiative


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Deep understanding of Channel Payments, distributor agreements, fees and rebates, inventory management rebates, DOH methodologies, scorecards, net sales reconciliations, payment package governance, and Gross\-to\-Net operations.
* Experience with Model N GCPS, SAP, Conga, IntegriChain, Tableau, Qlik, Power BI, Power Query, Alteryx, SharePoint, and automation technologies.
* Experience supporting SOX controls, operational audits, access governance, issue management, UAT activities, and system enhancements.
* Demonstrated success leading transitions, KT programs, process standardization, automation, reporting modernization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder management, executive\-ready communication, people leadership, analytical, and change\-management skills.

title: SAP SD
description:

 SAP certification in S4 HANA Sales or S4 HANA Logistics highly preferred

title: QA Lead (Copado Robotic testing)
description:
**What You Will Do**
 Let’s do this. Let’s change the world.
 **Amgen is seeking a QA Lead – Salesforce \& Copado Robotic Testing** 
 to lead quality engineering and testing capabilities for enterprise Salesforce platforms, including OneCRM and its integrated ecosystem. This role will be responsible for ensuring high\-quality, reliable, and compliant application releases through a combination of
 **manual, functional, integration, regression, and automated testing using Copado Robotic Testing (CRT)** 
 .
   

  

 The QA Lead will own the end\-to\-end testing strategy and execution, lead cross\-functional QA teams, and partner closely with business, product, engineering, architecture, and production support teams to ensure releases meet functional, technical, and quality expectations while supporting Amgen’s mission to serve patients.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**QA \& Testing Leadership**
* Lead end\-to\-end QA activities for Salesforce applications and their integrated ecosystem, ensuring high\-quality releases with minimal production defects.
* Define and drive the overall test strategy, test planning, execution, defect management, and reporting across releases.
* Lead testing activities across functional, integration, system, regression, end\-to\-end, and user acceptance testing phases.
* Ensure appropriate test coverage based on business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, technical designs, and integration specifications.
* Serve as the primary QA point of contact for product, business, engineering, and technology stakeholders.


**Manual \& Functional Testing**
* Lead comprehensive manual testing of Salesforce applications, including business processes, workflows, validations, security, profiles, permission sets, and user experience.
* Design, review, and maintain test scenarios, test cases, test data, and expected results.
* Ensure adequate coverage of positive, negative, boundary, exception, and end\-to\-end business scenarios.
* Validate complex Salesforce business processes spanning multiple objects, personas, applications, and integrations.
* Drive exploratory and risk\-based testing for business\-critical capabilities.


**Copado Robotic Testing \& Test Automation**
* Lead adoption and implementation of Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) for Salesforce test automation.
* Design and maintain reusable, scalable, and maintainable automated test suites using Copado Robotic Testing.
* Identify appropriate manual regression scenarios for automation based on business criticality, repeatability, and ROI.
* Establish and continuously improve the automated regression test suite to increase coverage and reduce manual testing effort.
* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD and release pipelines wherever applicable.
* Monitor automation execution results, investigate failures, and ensure timely maintenance of automated test scripts.
* Define standards and best practices for Copado Robotic Testing development, execution, and maintenance.


**Integration \& End\-to\-End Testing**
* Lead end\-to\-end testing across Salesforce and integrated enterprise platforms, including MuleSoft APIs, Databricks, and other upstream/downstream applications.
* Validate API integrations, data transformations, interface processing, error handling, and data reconciliation.
* Coordinate testing dependencies across multiple application and technology teams.
* Ensure critical business journeys are validated across the complete application and integration landscape.


**Defect Management \& Quality Governance**
* Establish and enforce standardized defect management, triage, prioritization, and closure processes.
* Lead defect triage sessions with business, development, and product teams.
* Ensure defects are appropriately categorized based on severity, priority, business impact, and release risk.
* Track defect trends, leakage, reopen rates, and recurring quality issues.
* Drive root cause analysis for escaped production defects and implement preventive actions.
* Establish appropriate quality gates and release\-readiness criteria before production deployment.


**Test Planning \& Release Management**
* Develop comprehensive test plans and testing schedules aligned with sprint and release timelines.
* Estimate QA effort and determine appropriate testing capacity based on release scope and complexity.
* Coordinate QA activities across Agile sprints, major releases, hotfixes, patches, and production maintenance releases.
* Assess testing risks and proactively communicate potential impacts to release timelines.
* Provide clear QA sign\-off and release\-readiness recommendations based on test results, open defects, and residual risks.
* Support post\-production validation and hypercare testing following major releases.


**Quality Engineering \& Continuous Improvement**
* Drive the transition from traditional testing toward a quality engineering and automation\-first approach.
* Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive manual testing through automation.
* Improve test efficiency through reusable test assets, automation, standardized processes, and optimized test data management.
* Establish QA standards, templates, metrics, and best practices across the delivery organization.
* Leverage defect and production incident trends to continuously strengthen regression coverage.
* Promote shift\-left testing, enabling early QA involvement during requirements, refinement, and solution\-design activities.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Partner with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, Developers, Scrum Masters, and Production Support teams throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Participate in requirements and user\-story refinement to ensure requirements and acceptance criteria are clear, testable, and complete.
* Collaborate with upstream and downstream application teams to coordinate integration and end\-to\-end testing.
* Act as the bridge between business and technology teams for quality\-related discussions.
* Communicate testing progress, risks, defects, dependencies, and release readiness to leadership and key stakeholders.


**Team Leadership**
* Lead and mentor onshore/offshore QA and test automation teams.
* Drive appropriate allocation of QA resources based on release priorities and workload.
* Provide technical and functional guidance to manual and automation testers.
* Establish standards for test documentation, traceability, automation, and defect management.
* Drive knowledge sharing, cross\-skilling, and capability development within the QA team.
* Mentor team members on Salesforce testing, Copado Robotic Testing, quality engineering, and testing best practices.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* 9–13 years of overall experience in Quality Assurance, Software Testing, or Quality Engineering.
* Significant experience leading QA activities for large\-scale enterprise applications and complex releases.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strong experience in Salesforce functional and manual testing.
* Hands\-on experience with Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) for Salesforce test automation.
* Strong understanding of the Salesforce platform, preferably including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and/or Health Cloud.
* Experience developing and maintaining automated regression test suites.
* Experience testing Salesforce integrations, MuleSoft APIs, REST/SOAP services, and data interfaces.
* Experience with enterprise data platforms such as Databricks is preferred.
* Experience with end\-to\-end, integration, regression, API, and data validation testing.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies and CI/CD practices.
* Familiarity with Copado, Jira, ServiceNow, or similar enterprise delivery and ticketing platforms.
* Experience with test management and defect tracking tools.
* Strong understanding of test automation strategy, quality gates, and release\-readiness criteria.
* Experience working in regulated environments, preferably pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences.
* Understanding of GxP, compliance, data privacy, and validation requirements is preferred.
* Proven experience managing distributed onshore/offshore QA teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.


**Soft Skills**
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal abilities with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
* High attention to detail and a strong commitment to quality and customer experience.
* Ability to prioritize multiple testing activities and deliver effectively under tight release timelines.
* Strong ownership and accountability for application quality.
* Team\-oriented with a proactive and collaborative mindset.
* Ability and willingness to mentor QA engineers and promote testing and automation best practices.
* Ability to challenge requirements and solutions constructively from a quality and end\-user perspective.
* Adaptable to changing business priorities, project requirements, and evolving technology.


**What You Can Expect Of Us**
 As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for our teammates’ professional and personal growth and well\-being.
   

  

 Together, we live the Amgen values as we continue advancing science to serve patients.

title: Project Management Officer
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different in what we do, how we work, and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for an organised, detail\-oriented and proactive individual to manage small projects end to end and to support Project Managers and Project Analysts in the day\-to\-day coordination, tracking and governance of larger Change, Transformation and Transition (Lift\-Out) projects across Global Client Delivery (GCD) locations. The ideal candidate will independently run small, well\-scoped projects and ad hoc initiatives using the team's SWAT and Transition frameworks, while acting as the operational backbone of the Projects team – keeping plans, trackers, action logs and evidence current; scheduling and minuting governance forums; chasing actions to closure; and ensuring the team's tools and templates are consistently used. This is an individual contributor role in the Projects team with no direct reports, reporting to the Head of Projects, and is the foundation for a career in project and programme management at Alter Domus.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Small Project Management**
* Independently manage small, well\-scoped projects and ad hoc initiatives (e.g. single\-team process changes, small work transfers or Transition Lite items, tooling or reporting roll\-outs, remediation actions) from kick\-off to closure, applying the SWAT and Toll Gate frameworks proportionately
* Define scope, success criteria, timeline and stakeholders for small projects with the Business / CD Lead, publish a simple plan and run regular check\-points to drive the actions to completion
* Identify and log risks, issues and dependencies for own projects, resolve them at working level and escalate to the Head of Projects or a Project Manager where a decision or intervention is required
* Provide status updates on own projects into the team's weekly reporting and governance forums and complete closure and lessons\-learnt documentation


**Project Coordination \& Tracking**
* Maintain project plans, trackers and checklists for assigned projects – including the Transition Checklist, recruitment / onboarding tracker, access and IT tracker, training completion records and impacted\-teams register – ensuring they are accurate and up to date at all times
* Track actions, owners and due dates from all project meetings and proactively follow up with owners across Business, Tech, Client Delivery and cross\-functional teams to drive closure
* Support the Project Manager / Project Analyst in preparing detailed plans, timelines and milestone schedules and in updating them as the project evolves
* Own defined workstreams within larger Transition and Transformation projects under the guidance of a Project Manager


**Governance Forums \& Toll Gate Support**
* Organise and support governance forums – schedule Tier 2 (weekly) and Tier 3 (operational) meetings, bi\-weekly transition reviews and toll\-gate (TG1/TG2/TG3\) reviews; prepare agendas, circulate pre\-reads, capture minutes, decisions and actions and distribute them promptly
* Collect, file and index toll\-gate evidence (sign\-off emails, approved plans, acceptance forms, training and access confirmations) in the designated SharePoint / Confluence locations and keep the evidence checklist current
* Chase pending sign\-offs from LoB, CD Leads, GPOs, Academy, IT and Control Tower ahead of toll\-gate dates and flag anything at risk to the Project Manager
* Maintain the decision log and action log for assigned projects


**Risk, Issue \& Dependency Logging**
* Capture risks, issues and dependencies raised in meetings and by stakeholders into the RAID log with clear descriptions, owners and target dates
* Monitor open items for ageing and overdue status and highlight them to the Project Manager / Project Analyst for escalation
* Support the preparation of escalation notes and mitigation trackers


**Reporting \& Documentation**
* Prepare first drafts of status reports – weekly project updates, the consolidated GCD Projects weekly update and governance packs – by collecting inputs from Project Managers, Tech PMO and stakeholders and populating the standard templates
* Update KPI trackers and dashboards (hiring progress, onboarding, training completion, KC/KT scorecards, milestone status) with validated data from source teams
* Maintain project documentation – charters, stakeholder lists, RACI, communication plans, SOP / process documentation packs received from LoBs – with correct version control
* Ensure all project artefacts are stored in the agreed structure on SharePoint / Confluence and are easy for stakeholders to find


**Stakeholder Coordination \& Communication**
* Act as the day\-to\-day point of contact for routine queries, data requests and scheduling across global delivery locations and time zones
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams – Talent Acquisition, Academy (KC/KT), IT / Access, Risk, Legal \& Compliance, Facilities and Control Tower – to obtain inputs and confirm completion of their actions
* Draft clear and professional meeting invites, minutes, follow\-up notes and status communications for review by the Project Manager
* Build effective working relationships with stakeholders and represent the Projects team professionally


**Tools, Templates \& PMO Administration**
* Administer Jira boards, Confluence spaces and SharePoint libraries for assigned projects – creating and updating items, maintaining workflows and access lists and ensuring data hygiene
* Apply the team's standard templates (Transition Acceptance Document, Transition Checklist, SWAT templates, status report and RAID templates) and suggest practical improvements based on usage
* Support onboarding of new project stakeholders to the team's tools and ways of working
* Support post\-project reviews by collating feedback, lessons learnt and closure documentation


**PROFILE**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Finance, Operations or related field
* Project management foundation certification (CAPM, PRINCE2 Foundation, Agile / Scrum fundamentals) or willingness to obtain within the first year
* Overall 3\-7 years' experience in back office, BPO or Financial Services domain
* 2\-5 years of project coordination and execution experience – supporting or running projects, workstreams or process changes in a project, PMO or operations role
* Exposure to transitions, process migrations, change initiatives or working with global / multi\-location teams an advantage


**Technical Skills**
* Proficient in Excel (pivots, lookups, basic charts), PowerPoint and Outlook; exposure to Power BI an advantage
* Working knowledge of collaboration and project tools – SharePoint, MS Teams, Jira, Confluence or equivalent
* Familiarity with basic project management concepts – plans, milestones, RAID logs, action tracking, minutes


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
   

  

**Our Global Benefits Also Include**
* Support for professional accreditations
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location


 Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.
   

  

 (Alter Domus Privacy notice can be reviewed via Alter Domus webpage: https://alterdomus.com/privacy\-notice/)

title: Transformation Officer
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different in what we do, how we work, and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

 The Transformation Officer is an intellectually curious, analytically driven role at the foundation of the Transformation Office. Working as a core member of a transformation program team, this individual supports the delivery of discrete workstreams by conducting structured business analysis, gathering and synthesising operational data, mapping processes, engaging with subject matter experts, and producing clear outputs that drive informed decision\-making and program progress.
   

  

 This is an ideal role for an early\-career professional with the mindset of a consultant — someone who is energised by problem\-solving, takes initiative to dig into the detail, and takes pride in producing high\-quality, rigorous work. The Transformation Officer will work closely alongside global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business, gaining broad exposure to the firm's operations and technology landscape while contributing meaningfully to real transformation outcomes from day one.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
**Analysis \& Research**
* Conduct structured current\-state analysis to understand existing processes, workflows, roles, and operational pain points, through interviews, workshops, and data review
* Gather, clean, and analyse quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement
* Develop and maintain process maps, data models, and analytical frameworks that underpin workstream findings and recommendations
* Analyse interdependencies between people, process, technology, and governance elements of the operating model, under the guidance of the Senior Officer or Program Lead
* Proactively research best practices, benchmarks, and comparable approaches to inform solution design
* Contribute to the development of business cases, options papers, and other analytical outputs that inform senior decision\-making


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Requirements Gathering**
* Engage day\-to\-day with global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business to gather information, validate analysis, and support the change process
* Support the facilitation of workshops and interviews with stakeholders across functions to capture requirements, surface pain points, and gather input
* Assist in translating business needs into clear, structured requirements and user stories for technology and process workstreams
* Support change impact assessments and stakeholder mapping activities
* Build constructive working relationships with subject matter experts and operational counterparts across the business
* Communicate findings and workstream updates clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing, in a manner appropriate to the audience


**Technology\-Enabled Transformation**
* Support work with Global Process Owners, Tech, Product, and Operations teams to understand technology solutions and their implications for the operating model
* Contribute to the definition of functional requirements and business logic for tech\-enabled tools, workflows, and automation opportunities
* Develop an active awareness of AI and agentic AI tools and their potential to create value within transformation workstreams, in line with Alter Domus's AI governance framework
* Assist in ensuring alignment between business processes and system capabilities, flagging gaps and inconsistencies for resolution


**Workstream Support \& Delivery**
* Support the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned workstreams, taking ownership of defined tasks and deliverables within the broader program plan
* Maintain up\-to\-date workstream documentation, including process maps, trackers, issue logs, and meeting notes
* Assist with data analysis, reporting, and insights to inform program governance and decision\-making
* Participate in testing, user acceptance, and validation activities to ensure solutions meet business needs
* Identify and escalate risks, blockers, and dependencies promptly, with an initial view on potential solutions
* Demonstrate a self\-starter attitude — proactively progressing work without waiting for direction, and consistently delivering to a high standard


**Change Management \& Documentation**
* Support the design and delivery of change activities, including communications, training materials, and readiness assessments
* Help identify change resistance and contribute to strategies that build engagement and adoption across impacted teams
* Produce clear, well\-structured documentation of current\-state and future\-state processes, including standard operating procedures (SOPs), playbooks, and knowledge assets to enable smooth transition to new ways of working
* Contribute to knowledge transfer activities and ensure workstream outputs are thoroughly recorded and accessible for BAU teams


**Essential**
**Skills \& Experience Required:**
* 3\-4 years of professional experience in management consulting, business analysis, operations, financial services, or a related analytical field; exceptional recent graduates will also be considered
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills — able to structure problems clearly, analyse data rigorously, and draw well\-reasoned conclusions
* High attention to detail with a commitment to producing accurate, high\-quality work
* Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present information in a structured and compelling way
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ability to build clean models and well\-structured presentations
* A proactive, self\-starting mindset — intellectually curious, eager to learn, and comfortable taking initiative in ambiguous situations
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment
* High levels of personal drive, ownership, and accountability


**Desirable**
* Domain knowledge in one or more of the following:
+ Fund Administration (e.g., NAV production, investor reporting, transfer agency, custody operations, or related middle/back\-office processes)
+ Financial Services Technology (e.g., platforms, infrastructure, system implementations, or digital transformation)
+ AI Enablement (e.g., GenAI adoption, process automation, AI\-assisted workflows, or data\-driven transformation)

* Sound understanding of how regulated financial services entities operate, with some exposure to fund administration, private equity, alternative investments, or wealth management
* Exposure to regulatory change programmes or compliance\-driven transformation
* Experience with service design, customer journey mapping, or lean/six sigma methodologies
* Prior exposure to process improvement, project delivery, or transformation activity in any context (professional or academic)
* Familiarity with process mapping or collaboration tools (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart, Miro, Confluence, Jira)
* Familiarity with project management or change management frameworks (e.g., Agile, PRINCE2, Prosci, Kotter)
* Familiarity with technology concepts such as workflow automation, system integration, APIs, and cloud\-based platforms
* Business analysis certification (e.g., BCS, IIBA/CBAP) or Agile/Scrum certification (CSM, CSPO) a plus
* Undergraduate or postgraduate degree from a leading institution, ideally in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a field with role\-relevant transferable skills


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
   

  

**Our Global Benefits Also Include**
* Support for professional accreditations
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location

title: Electrical and Instrumentation Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Dhanlakshmi Packaging Industries Pvt. Ltd. (DPIPL) is an India\-based manufacturer providing high\-quality, sustainable packaging solutions across corrugated packaging, labels, sleeves, and paper\-based products. Established in 2002, the company has grown into a multi\-location organization with advanced European and Taiwanese machinery, serving sectors such as FMCG, food and beverages, e\-commerce, electronics, paints, cosmetics, solar, and agriculture. With manufacturing facilities in Hyderabad and Nellore, DPIPL offers end\-to\-end capabilities from packaging design and R\&D to production and quality assurance. The company operates fully automatic corrugators, high\-end converting lines, multi\-colour flexo printing, advanced label and shrink sleeve systems, and paper\-based lollipop stick production. DPIPL maintains strict quality, safety, and compliance standards through certifications including ISO 9001, ISO 22000, BRCGS, SEDEX, FSC\-CoC, and FSSC 22000, and is committed to responsible, innovative, and sustainable packaging solutions.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site role for an Electrical and Instrumentation Manager based at DPIPL’s Hyderabad facility. The role involves overseeing electrical and instrumentation systems across the plant, including installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and optimization of machinery and equipment. The manager will lead a team of electrical and instrumentation technicians, ensure adherence to safety and compliance standards, and coordinate preventive and predictive maintenance activities to minimize downtime. The position includes planning and executing electrical and instrumentation projects, managing budgets and timelines, and collaborating with production, quality, and engineering teams to support operational efficiency and process improvements. The manager will also maintain documentation, supervise inspections, and drive continuous improvement initiatives in alignment with organizational goals.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Electrical Engineering skills, including design, installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of industrial electrical systems.
* Candidates should possess solid Instrumentation skills, with experience in process control instruments, automation systems, sensors, PLCs, and calibration practices.
* Candidates should possess effective Supervisory Skills, including team leadership, task allocation, performance monitoring, and training of technical staff.
* Candidates should possess Project Management and Project Control skills for planning, scheduling, budgeting, and controlling electrical and instrumentation projects.
* Relevant qualifications such as a bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, or a related field.
* Experience in manufacturing or packaging industries, preferably with automated production lines and advanced machinery.
* Knowledge of industrial safety standards, compliance requirements, and best practices for electrical and instrumentation systems.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.

title: Manager Central Monitoring
description:
**Build Our Future Together**
 Regeneron is founded on the belief that the right idea, combined with the right team, can lead to significant transformations. Our growing global network is dedicated to inventing, developing, and commercializing medicines that change lives for those with serious diseases. In doing so, we are pioneering innovative approaches to science, manufacturing, and commercialization, as well as redefining our understanding of health.
   

  

 At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life\-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We are seeking a Manager, Central Monitoring, Data Analysis to join our Global Clinical Trial Services team. In this role, you will oversee centralized monitoring activities for global and complex clinical trials and support the configuration, execution, and maintenance of Risk\-Based Quality Management (RBQM) platforms. You will leverage your programming and analytical expertise to create customized analyses, automate workflows, integrate data systems, and deliver actionable insights that support informed decision\-making and optimize clinical trial performance. You may also oversee multiple studies within an assigned therapeutic area, lead process\-improvement initiatives, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams and industry partners to advance central monitoring capabilities.
   

  

**When \& Where**
 Hyderabad, India (hybrid)
   

  

**Discover Your Role**
* Act as a subject\-matter expert for the configuration, implementation, and execution of Central Monitoring RBQM platforms across studies.
* Maintain Regeneron Central Monitoring Key Risk Indicator and Quality Tolerance Limit libraries to ensure consistent deployment across studies and alignment with regulatory requirements.
* Configure studies within an RBQM platform by partnering with functional and cross\-functional stakeholders to develop Central Monitoring configuration specifications.
* Provide operational expertise, training, and guidance, serving as an escalation point for issues related to the Central Monitoring RBQM platform.
* Conduct central monitoring reviews as required, including recurring data refreshes and troubleshooting execution errors in support of Study Central Monitors.
* Apply programming expertise to support Central Monitoring data analysis, automation, reporting, and system integration.
* Interpret and present Key Risk Indicator and Key Performance Indicator data to support informed decision\-making.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement and standardization of technologies, systems, processes, and training materials that support Central Monitoring and RBQM.
* Represent Central Monitoring in process\-improvement initiatives and collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
* Oversee multiple studies within an assigned therapeutic area, as applicable, and contribute to innovation in central monitoring capabilities.
* Travel up to 25%, as required.


**This Role Requires**
* At least 7 years of relevant biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry experience. Experience in Central Monitoring, site monitoring, or data management is preferred.
* A minimum of 2 years of direct experience with RBQM systems.
* Technical expertise in database design, system configuration, and report development, with experience managing RBQM or similar platforms.

* Strong analytical, critical\-thinking, and problem\-solving skills, including experience troubleshooting data refreshes and resolving execution errors in analytical systems.
* Working knowledge of the clinical drug\-development process, including ICH and GCP guidelines and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Experience with clinical databases, electronic data\-capture systems, quality\-control processes, and auditing procedures.

* The ability to collaborate across cross\-functional teams and build effective internal and external relationships.

title: Shift Manager
description:
**Business Unit:**
 Cubic Transportation Systems
   

  

**Company Details:**
 When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.
   

  

 We have a top\-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.
   

  

**Job Details:**
**Job Summary**
 As a Shift Coordinator on the CTS 24x7 Service Operations team, you will provide direct supervision to Tier 1 and Tier 2 staff across the Network Operations Center (NOC), Security Operations Center (SOC), and Service Desk during your assigned shift. You act as the technical and operational command authority during the shift. You are responsible for ensuring that events across all three functions are correctly triaged, tickets are properly assigned and tracked, incidents are escalated per defined protocols, and shift handovers preserve full situational awareness for the incoming shift.
   

  

 You are responsible for confirming shift staffing coverage in real time and for adjusting assignments to accommodate last\-minute absences. You are the immediate escalation path for issues that exceed the authority of the Tier 1 and Tier 2 analysts on the shift, and you escalate to the Director of Technical Service Operations for issues that exceed shift authority.
   

  

 Work is conducted under the compliance frameworks that govern CTS operations, in particular ITIL 4 (Monitoring and Event Management, Incident Management, Continual Improvement), ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (Annex A logging, monitoring, and incident management controls), and PCI DSS v4\.0\.1 (Requirements 10 and 12\.10\). You will be recognized inside CTS as the shift\-level owner for cross\-function coordination and evidence continuity.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities**
**Shift Command and Team Coordination**
* Provide direct supervision to Tier 1 and Tier 2 NOC, SOC, and Service Desk analysts during the assigned shift.
* Assign work at shift start and re\-balance workload throughout the shift based on ticket volume, incident severity, and individual analyst capacity.
* Confirm complete shift coverage across NOC, SOC, and Service Desk queues at shift start; adjust in real time when staff are unavailable because of sick calls, unplanned PTO, or emergency absence.
* Serve as the initial escalation point for any Tier 1 or Tier 2 analyst who needs additional authority, judgment, or cross\-functional coordination.
* Track and report shift\-level metrics (ticket volume, SLA adherence, incident count by severity) at shift close.


**Shift Handover Discipline**
* Execute a formal shift handover at the start and end of every shift, per the protocols defined in the NOC Scope Definition and the CTS SOC Scope of Operations.
* Ensure the handover record captures, at minimum: open incidents with owner and next action; active containment actions in progress; watchlist items; active maintenance windows; tooling or coverage gaps.
* Retain handover records as ISMS evidence supporting ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.5\.10 and ITIL 4 Monitoring and Event Management practice.


**Incident Management Coordination**
* Apply ITIL 4 Incident Management practice throughout the shift: validate alerts, classify severity, assign ownership, coordinate escalation, and track resolution against SLA.
* Coordinate the first 15 to 30 minutes of any SEV 0 or SEV 1 incident: declare the incident, engage the appropriate tiers, initiate stakeholder communications, and hand off to the Incident Commander or on\-call Tier 3 engineer.
* Enforce severity special rules from the NOC Scope Definition (for example, loss of logging or monitoring is never a SEV 4 event; SEV 0 or SEV 1 with a recent production change requires a change correlation step).
* Ensure joint NOC\-SOC coordination during Major Incidents: NOC leads operational recovery; SOC leads security investigation and containment; the Shift Coordinator maintains the shared incident bridge until the Incident Commander takes over.


**Cross\-Function Ticket Routing and Escalation**
* Monitor NOC, SOC, and Service Desk queues in the ITSM platform; ensure tickets are correctly categorized and assigned per the RACI.
* Route security\-relevant events from the NOC or Service Desk to the SOC per the defined Escalation pathway with enriched context.
* Route operational recovery actions from the SOC to the NOC or regional IT Operations per the defined protocol.
* Escalate to the Director of Technical Service Operations for any issue that exceeds shift authority.


**Compliance Evidence and Documentation**
* Ensure shift activities produce audit\-ready evidence supporting PCI DSS v4\.0\.1 Requirement 10 and Requirement 12\.10, and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.5\.24\-A.5\.28 and A.8\.15\-A.8\.16\.
* Verify handover records, incident timelines, and containment action logs are complete and accurate before shift close.
* Support monthly and quarterly evidence pack preparation.


**Continuous Improvement Contribution**
* Identify recurring patterns during the shift (repeat incidents, noisy alerts, gaps in playbook coverage) and log them for review by the NOC, SOC, and Service Desk Managers.
* Participate in post\-incident reviews and contribute to the Continual Improvement Register per ITIL 4 Continual Improvement practice.
* Recommend changes to shift\-level procedures where the shift experience identifies opportunities.


**General Duties And Responsibilities**
* Reliably demonstrate accountability for work assignments and proactive communications about issues and status. A strong history of proactively identifying effective solutions for challenges.
* Able to work effectively and uphold professional standards, with the customer and system stakeholders.
* Self\-motivated and able to work unsupervised.
* Methodical and attentive to detail.
* Proactive in seeking advice from senior operations and security subject matter experts when required.
* Comfortable working with staff at all levels and in other geographical locations within the organization.
* Comply with Cubic's Quality Management System.
* Comply with Cubic's quality, health, safety, and security policies.
* Support the company's strategic objectives and collaborate across departments.
* Comply with Cubic Human Resources Procedures.


**Skills / Experience / Knowledge**
**Essential:**
* Experience providing direct supervision to a team of individual contributors in a technology operations, security operations, or service desk environment.
* Working knowledge of NOC operations: event monitoring, incident management, SLA management, change and configuration control.
* Working knowledge of SOC operations: SIEM and EDR alert triage, security incident classification, escalation protocols.
* Working knowledge of Service Desk operations under a Tier 1\-3 tiered model.
* Familiarity with ITIL 4 practices, in particular Monitoring and Event Management and Incident Management.
* Ability to interpret and explain incident status, containment actions, and escalation decisions to peers, subordinate staff, and functional peer groups. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Collaboration and Interaction expectations.
* Sound judgment in resolving problems that require analysis of data and relevant factors under real\-time pressure. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Complexity and Problem Solving expectations.
* Ability to develop and manage routine operational plans and meet targets against a monthly performance plan. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Discretion and Impact expectations.
* Experience preparing accurate shift reports and handover records.
* Comfort operating 24x7 shift patterns, including nights, weekends, and public holidays.


**Desirable:**
* Familiarity with PCI DSS v4\.0\.1 requirements, in particular Requirement 10, Requirement 11\.5, and Requirement 12\.10\.
* Familiarity with ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A controls covering logging (A.8\.15\), monitoring activities (A.8\.16\), and incident management (A.5\.24 to A.5\.28\).
* Exposure to NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2\.0 (NIST CSWP 29\) Detect and Respond Functions.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow (or equivalent enterprise ITSM) and Jira.
* Understanding of the ITIL 4 Major Incident model and Problem Management practice.
* Experience coordinating across NOC, SOC, and Service Desk boundaries.


**Qualifications**
**Essential:**
* Must be able to work on\-site at Cubic Hyderabad, Aparna Plaza, on a 24x7 rotating shift pattern.
* Minimum 5\-8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree.
* University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or other technical field; or Business Administration with relevant IT work experience.
* At least 5 years of experience in a Tier 1\-3 operations environment (NOC, SOC, Service Desk, or NOC/SOC hybrid).
* At least 3 years’ experience managing shift workers.
* Demonstrated ability to make severity classification and escalation decisions in a real\-time operations setting.
* Demonstrated ability to lead a team through a shift, including workload assignment, coaching, and formal handover.
* At least 3 years’ experience working in an ITIL 4 operation.


**Desirable:**
* ITIL 4 Foundation certification; ITIL 4 Managing Professional or Strategic Leader preferred.
* CompTIA Security\+, ISC2 SSCP, or equivalent security operations certification.
* ServiceNow ITSM administrator or user certification.
* Experience in a payment card processing environment, or in a similarly regulated real\-time operations environment.
* Experience with global follow\-the\-sun shift models spanning NAM, EMEA, and APAC time zones.


**Condition of Employment:**
 Successful outcome of a National Police Check

These firms are members of Deloitte Touché Tohmatsu Limited DTTL, a UK private company limited by guarantee. With 260,000\+ people in over 150 countries, Deloitte member firms serve more than 80 percent of the world's largest companies as well as large national enterprises, public institutions, and successful fast\-growing companies
   

  

**Deloitte Support Services India Pvt. Ltd**

title: ADMS Delivery Manager
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 As an ADMS Delivery Manager you will be a pivotal contributor to the successful delivery of ADMS Series 3 (DMS / OMS / SCADA) implementations and upgrades for electric utility customers across the MENAT and APAC regions. You will own the technical delivery of assigned projects across the full post\-sales lifecycle – from requirements and design through configuration, network model build, testing, cutover, go\-live and hypercare – working directly with customers and with cross\-functional GE Vernova teams.
   

  

 This role is dedicated to the Distribution GSL Series 3 delivery portfolio and operates under the direction of the regional ADMS Lead in MENAT as well as the HTC GDC leader . It combines deep ADMS technical expertise with customer\-facing delivery ownership, and contributes to building regional capability and reducing reliance on single points of expertise. Requiring a high level of operational and technical judgement, the expectation for this role is moderate autonomy.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**
* Project Delivery Ownership
+ Act as the technical delivery lead for assigned ADMS Series 3 implementations, upgrades and installed\-base engagements across MENAT and APAC.
+ Own technical deliverables throughout the entire project lifecycle – requirements, functional and technical design, system configuration, distribution network model (DNAF) build and validation, integration, FAT/SAT, cutover, go\-live and hypercare – ensuring projects stay on track in terms of budget, time and customer expectations.
+ Plan and track delivery activities, effort and milestones for assigned projects; report progress, risks, issues and change requests to the regional Delivery Manager and project stakeholders.
+ Help to lay out proper staffing to cover all regional ADMS S3 deliveries and coordinate GE Vernova, HTC and partner resources assigned to the project to ensure all projects are successful.
+ Manage defects, change requests and technical actions through GE Vernova project tracking tools, maintaining accurate and auditable delivery records.

* Client Collaboration
+ Serve as the primary technical point of contact for the customer on assigned projects, explaining difficult or sensitive information and working to build consensus.
+ Work closely with clients to understand their unique needs and develop tailored delivery strategies through site assessments and workshops.
+ Make standard recommendations on workflow, application, interface, reports, testing and data uploads to customers during the implementation process.
+ Ensure go\-live readiness and provide support, including post\-live checkups, to guarantee customer satisfaction.
+ Travel to customer sites in the regions as required by project phase, including extended on\-site presence during testing, cutover and go\-live windows.

* Technical Expertise and Installed Base Support
+ Provide hands\-on technical support and troubleshooting across the ADMS Series 3 stack (Habitat / SCADA, DMS applications, OMS / Enterprise OMS, DNAF and system interfaces), including production issue resolution for installed\-base customers.
+ Support upgrade planning and execution for the regional ADMS S3 installed base, including version assessments, configuration re\-verification and migration activities.
+ Contribute to solution design, sizing and effort estimation for change orders and new opportunities, supporting the regional sales and bid teams as required.

* Leadership and Mentorship
+ Act as a resource for colleagues with less experience; mentor regional engineers and support structured knowledge transfer to build redundancy and reduce reliance on a small number of senior SMEs.
+ Ability to work across all GEV silos – Product, Support, Sales, HTC and delivery partners – with a OneTeam mentality.
+ Ability to grow and mentor staff, understanding that not everyone learns and grows the same way.
+ Develop persuasion skills required to influence others on topics within field.

* Best Practice and Quality Assurance
+ Develop specialized knowledge in your discipline and serve as a best practice / quality resource for the regional ADMS team.
+ Stay abreast of the latest technical developments in ADMS Series 3 and the GridOS platform, and contribute to delivery standards, runbooks and reusable assets.
+ Ensure delivery excellence within your area of responsibility.

* Decision\-Making and Problem Solving
+ Use judgment to make decisions or solve moderately complex tasks or problems in areas of delivery, technology or engineering.
+ Take a new perspective on existing solutions and use technical experience and expertise for data analysis to support recommendations.
+ Utilize multiple internal and limited external sources outside of your own function to arrive at decisions.

* Market Awareness and Integration
+ Possess in\-depth knowledge of best practices and understand how your area integrates with others.
+ Have a working knowledge of the competition and the factors that differentiate them in the market.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Computer Science or a related discipline from an accredited university or college.
* Minimum of 15 years of experience implementing, upgrading or supporting ADMS / DMS / OMS / SCADA solutions for electric utilities, with significant hands\-on experience on GE Vernova ADMS Series 3\.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical delivery on utility software projects, including direct customer\-facing responsibility.
* Willingness and ability to travel internationally to customer sites across MENAT and APAC as required by project phase.
* Based in Hyderabad, India, and aligned with HTC workplace guidelines.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Masters degree in electrical engineering / Power systems
* Deep experience with distribution network model (DNAF) build, validation, migration and data quality management.
* Experience with OMS / Enterprise OMS, Habitat / SCADA, eFEP and ADMS integrations (GIS, CIS, AMI, IVR, SCADA).
* Experience with ADMS Series 3 version upgrades and installed\-base support.
* Exposure to the GridOS platform is a plus.
* Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Demonstrated ability to lead programs / projects. Ability to document, plan and execute programs. Established project management skills.
* Ability to work effectively across time zones with regional customers and distributed GE Vernova teams.


******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 Yes
